Ifumbire y'imborera irimo amoko atandukanye, ayo ingenzi n'aya akurikira: Ifumbire y'amatungo: Ni ifumbire iva ku matungo nk'inka, ihene, ingurube, inkwavu, inkoko. Ifumbire y'ikimoteri / ingarane: Ni ifumbire iva kubisigazwa by'ibihingwa, byo murugo, n'ibindi byose bibora. Ifumbire y'iminyorogoto: Ni ifumbire iva ku dukoko nyabuzima tw'iminyorogoto, turya ibibora tugasohora ifumbire cyange twapfa tukabora tugakora ifumbire. Ifumbire y'ibyatsi: Ni ifumbire y'ibyatsi bimera ku butaka ariko bifite ubushobozi bwo kubora mu gihe gito iyo babitabitse mu butaka. Ifumbire y'uduti n'ibyatsi bivangwa n'imyaka: Ni ifumbire iva ku ku duti cyange ibyatsi bivangwa n'imyaka bifite ubushobozi bwo gukurura umwuka wa azote mu kirere bikawushyira mu butaka.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi muri beterave; • Genzura umurima buri munsi witegereza neza uruhande rwo hasi rw'amababi kuko ari ho ubusimba dufata mu gihe twihisha izuba n'imvura. • Indwara ikunze kuzahaza beterave ni: Indwara y'ibidomo (Cercospora leaf spots of beets) (1a). Irwanwa utera usimburanya imiti ikurikira irimo cuwivure (copper) urugero gitenge, komanda na funguran, chlorothalonil (Daconil), carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim), sulfur (Thiovit), difenoconazole, azoxystrobin. REPUBULIKA Y ' U RWANDA; • Ibyonnyi bikunze kugarara ni inda (ifoto 1b). Birwanye utera imiti uyisimburanya nka abamectin, cypermethrin, profenofos + cypermethrin.

Gutegura pepeniyere y'iboberi: batera ingeri z'ibobere zifite uburebure buri hagati ya cm 15 - 20, hagati y'igiti n'ikindi harimo cm 15 naho umurongo n'undi harimo cm 30. Ibobere imara muri pepeniyere amazi 4 kugera kuri 6 hanyuma ikabona kujya guterwa mu murima. Aho pepeniyeri iri hagomba kuba hari amazi kuburyo yuhirwa, ugomba gushyiramo ifumbire y'imborera hamwe n'imvaruganda ya urea mu mezi abiri ya mbere.

Guhunika soya bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Soya ihunikwa igomba kuba yumye neza ku buryo igipimo cy'amazi mu ntete kitajya hejuru ya 11 %. % (Iyo udafite ibikoresho bipima ubu buhehere ukoresha iryinyo iyo soya ihise imeneka iba yumye neza), Ihunikwa ahantu hari umwuka, humutse kandi hatagera ibyonnyi. Imifuka igomba gupangwa ku dutanda tw'imbaho (palettes) ntigire aho ihurira n'ubukonje bwo hasi. Soya ihunikwa igihe gito (ntirenza ibihembwe2 by'ihinga) kubera ko yangizwa n'ubushyuhe ndetse n'ubuhehere birengeje urugero. Ni ngombwa rero gutera imbuto isaruwe vuba. Mu gihe utizeye neza ubwiza bw'imbuto ugiye gutera, ningombwa gukora isuzuma mimerere yazo mbere yo kuzitera.

Ibiranga Milidiyu y'ifu (Powdery mildew) muri watermelon; Ibidomo cyangwa amabara byeruruka ku mababi bitwikiriwe n'agafu k'ikigina. Amababi areruruka nyuma akaba umuhondo. Imitwe y'amababi iruma. Uko birinda Milidiyu y'ifu (Powdery mildew) muri watermelon; Gusimburanya neza ibihingwa, Kuvana mu murima ibisagazwa by'ibihingwa bigakorwamo ifumbire, Gutera umuti urimo sufure cyangwa cuivre; Uko bavura Milidiyu y'ifu (Powdery mildew) muri watermelon; Gutera umuti urimo sufure nka Sulfur 80 % (Thiovit) cyangwa umuti urimo cuivre nka Kopper oxychloride ku gipimo cya garama 37. 5 kuri litiiro 15 z'amazi.

Inkoko z'ibigwana z'inyama zikerena ibi bikurikira: Icyo kunyweramo kimwe kijyamo litiro eshatu z'amazi ku nkoko 50 z'imishwi, iyo zikuze hakenewe icyo kunyweramo kimwe cya litiro icumi. Icyo kuriramo kimwe gifite uburebure bwa metero imwe kumishwi 50, zakura zigakenera icyo kuriramo kimwe kijyamo ibiro 20 by'ibiryo.

Indwara y'Ibidomo by'ibijuju mu matunda: INdwara y'Ibidomo by'ibijuju mu matunda iterwa n'agahumyo bita Alternaria passifloracea. Ibimenyetso by'Indwara y'Ibidomo by'ibijuju mu matunda: Igaragazwa n'ibice bya marakuja byafashwe hazaho ububabuke bw'uruziga bufite ibara ry'ikijuju kandi ku matunda ibidomo byinjiramo maze yakara igatuma amatunda abora. Uko Indwara y'Ibidomo by'ibijuju mu matunda bayirwanya: - Kutegeranya ingemwe mu gihe cy'itera, - Gukata ibisambo no kugabanya amashami. amababi hakinjira urumuri mumurima, - Gukoresha imiti irimo cuivre nka copper oxychloride / hudroxide.

Zifata cyane cyane amababi n'uruti bikiri bito, indabo n'amababi yo hasi. Inda zikwirakwiza virusi nyinshi zitera indwara. Umusaruro w'inkoko: Uretse ubwoko bw'inkoko zitera, hari n'ubwoko bw'izitanga inyama, ari bwo bita mu gifaransa “ poulet de chair ” Mu mezi abiri, inkoko y'ubwo bwoko ishobora kuba ipima ikilo kimwe n'amagarama 6 itabaze; Iyo ibaze ishobora gutanga umusaruro wa 70 % (inkoko ifite kg 1, 6 ari nzima itanga kg 1, 120 z'inyama); Inkoko zisanzwe zo, zishobora gutanga umusaruro wa 60 % w'inyama; Inkoko yo mu bwoko bwa RIR (Rhode Island Red) ishobora gutera ku mwaka amagi 220 iyo yafashwe neza. Ni ukuvuga umusaruro w'amagi wa 60 %; Inkoko yo mu bwoko Derco, iyo ifashwe neza ishobora gutera amagi 250 ku mwaka. Ni ukuvuga umusaruro wa 69 % ku mwaka; Hari ubundi bwoko bushobora gutera amagi 300 ku mwaka, aha twavuga nka Warren; Inkoko isanzwe ya kinyarwanda ishobora gutera amagi 60 kugeza kuri 90 ku mwaka. Mu bwoko bwa kinyarwanda, hagenda habamo zimwe ziba nziza kuruta izindi.

Guhunika ibigori bikorwa muri ubu buryo: Guhunika ibigori bikorwa mu buryo bwitondewe hitabwa ku bintu by'ingenzi bikurikiraGuhitamo aho guhunika: Hagomba kuba hatanyagirwa cyangwa ngo harekemo amazi; Kuba hatari ubuhehere bwinshi; Hashobora kwinjiza umwuka; Kuba hatari ibyonyi nk'imbeba, imiswa n'ibindi; Gusukura aho guhunika no kuhatera imiti; Guhitamo uburyo bwo gupanga imifuka; Gusukura imyaka no kurebaniba yumye neza ikaba ifite ubuhehere bwa 13 % Gusukura imifuka; Gutandukanya sitoki y'imyaka ishaje n'imishya; Kutarambika imifuka hasi hagakoreshwa imbaho cyangwa amabuye.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi muri dodo n'imbwija; Ibibazo byinshi by'indwara bikunze kuboneka mu mirima ishaje. Udukoko twitwa Uburima (aphids) ” rimwe na rimwe n'uburondwe buto (mites) nitwo dukunze guteza ibibazo. Amoko amwe n'amwe y'imbwija na dodo arwara virusi ariko muri rusange, imbwija / dodo ntizikunze kurwara. Rwanya uburima (Aphids) ubagara neza umurima wawe ndetse wirinda ubucucike kuko birwanya kororoka kwatwo. Tera imiti karemano ku bihingwa nka nimu (neem) cyangwa amazi avanze n'isabune. Watera ho kandi imiti yica udukoko nka abamectin na alfa - cypermethrin.

Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya Kabore y'imyumbati ni ubu bukurikira: Gutera ubwoko bw'imyumbati bwihanganira indwara ya Kabore. Gutera ingeri zitarwaye zavuye mu mirima yakurikiranywe n'inzego zibishinzwe. Gusura umurima w'imyumbati kenshi nibura rimwe mu kwezi cg mu mezi atatu. Gushyiraho akato kabuza abantu kwinjiza imyumbati ivuye mu duce twagaragayemo Kabore. Gukoresha ibikoresho bitakoreshejwe mu mirima irwaye cyangwa byacishijwe ku muriro mu gihe cy'iminota 2 cyangwa byogejwe muri JIK (mililitiro 750 muri litiro 15 z'amazi).

Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya indwara y'amabara akora inguni mubishyimbo ni ubu bukurikiraGutera imbuto ihungiye hakoreshejwe imiti nka Benomyl cyangwa se rhidomil no gukoresha amoko y'imbuto y'ibishyimbo yihanganira indwara. Mu gihe urimo ubagara ukoresheje isuka irinde gukomeretsa imizi kuko byatuma igihingwa gifatwa n'ubu burwayi; Kwirinda gutembera mu murima igihe hatose; Koresha isaso kugirango itaka ridatarukira kubihingwa; Sukura ibikoresho mbere yo kubikoresha mumirima y'ibishyimbo itandukanye; Twika ibisigazwa by'ibihingwa birwaye nyuma yo gusarura cgse ubigaburire amatungo; Cukura utwobo duto mu murima dukamure amazi Sukira ubutaka kugihingwa kugirango imizi y'igihingwa ikure neza; Tera imbuto mu ubutaka kuburyo utazitaba kure muri sentimetero eshanu.

GUTEGURA UMURIMA WO GUTERAMO POME bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira; - Hinga umurima neza uvanemo urwiri. - Ni ngombwa kubanza kugaragaza mu murima ahazaterwa ibiti bya pome, hagashingwa imambo. Pome ziterwa ku ntera ya m 4 x m 4. - Cukura imyobo ya cm 60 mu mpande na cm 60 mu bujyakuzimu. Igitaka cyo hejuru muri cm 30 gishyirwa uruhande rumwe aricyo gisubiramo kivanze n'ifumbire, ibyo bigakorwa nibura icyumweru mbere yo gutera. - Mu mwobo umwe hashyirwamo ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza ingana nibura n'ibase imwe kugeza kuri ebyiri (kg 20 - 30). Imborera ikenerwa kuri hegitare ni toni 12. 5 – 19. - Byaba byiza umurima ushyizweho uruzitiro kuko birinda indwara, ibyonnyi bitandukanye ndetse n'umuyaga. Aha hashobora gukoreshwa ibiti bitanga ifumbire y'azote nka Kariyandara (Calliandra) cyangwa Resena (Leucaena).

IBYONNYI BYO MU BUHUNIKIRO bya soya ni ibi bikurikira: Ibyonnyi bikomeye bya soya mu buhunikiro n'imbeba. Imbeba zirya impeke izo ari zo zose zaba inzima, izamenaguritse cyangwa izabaye ifu. Zangiza cyane umusaruro kuko ziwandurisha ubwoya bwazo, inkari ndetse n'amahurunguru yazo. Uburyo bwo kuzirwanya; Mu rwego rwo kwirinda imbeba mu buhunikiro hakoreshwa imitego (rwagakoco) cyangwa se bakazitegesha imiti yabugenewe yo kuzica.

Ibimenyetso biranga indwara y'isazi y'umuceri ni ibi: Isazi itera amagi akavamo inyo ari nazo zangiza cyane. Isazi n'inyo byombi birya amababi, bikanyunyuzamo amazi. Izi nyo zangiza nka nkongwa zizamuka mu ntimatima zihereye mu mizi noneho zikarya umutima w'igikenyeri. Umuceri wafashwe utarabumbura uhinduka umuhondo. Iyo umuceri ufashwe umaze guhagika cyangwa mbere yo kuraba, amahundo ntiyirema neza, nta n'impeke zizamo.

Igihe kiboneye cyo gusarura ni igihe hafi ya 10 % ry'intete ziri ku ihundo zikiri icyatsi kibisi nyuma y'iminsi 40 - 50 umuceri umaze gusambura bitewe n'ubwoko n'igipimo cy'ubushyuhe mu gihe umuceri uri kwera.

Udutagangurirwa dushobora gukwirakwira mu giti cyangwa mu biti byinshi binyuze mu nzira nyinshi. Utwinshi dushobora kugendagenda dutembera mu mashami. Dushobora kandi gutwarwa n'umuyaga, imvura, inyoni, utundi dusimba, abantu cyangwa ibikoresho. Ingemwe zo mubuhumbikiro zishobora kwanduzwa no gukoresha imibangurizo (scions) zifite utu dusimba.  Uko twangiza; Udutagangurirwa twangiza indabo; kandi twigaburira twangiza imbuto tugatera imbuto gusa n'ikijuju zikaba nk'izikomeye ndetse n'amababi akagwa.  Kutwirinda no kuturwanya; Udutagangurirwa twinshi tw'ibinyamacunga ntabwo dupfa kuboneshwa amaso. Igihe ibimenyetso byinshi byatwo byamaze kugaragara, gutera umuti biba byakererewe. Ni byiza kugenzura buri gihe ko udutagangurirwa twageze mumurima tutarangiza cyane. Mu kugenzura, ufata urupapuro rwera ukarushyira munsi y'amababi ukazunguza amababi; iyo udutagangurirwa (udukoko duto tw'ibara ritukura) duhari utubona ku rupapuro tugenda. Ikindi kandi, aho utu dusimba turi uhasanga imitego nk'iyibitagangurirwa bisanzwe. Gutera umuti igihe harimo udutagangurirwa duke cyane singombwa kuko biba byongera igishoro kandi inshuti z'abahinzi nazo ziba zashobora kurwanya utwo dutagangurirwa. Igihe ibiti bimwe cyangwa imirongo y'ibiti ariyo igaragaza uburwayi gusa, gutera imiti bikorwa gusa kuri ibyo biti. Igihe gutera umuti ari ngombwa, hakoreshwa Abamectine - [Dudu acelamectin, Romectine].

Ibimenyetso birananga indwara y'akaribata (Anthracnose) ya puwavuro; Akaribata ni indwara yangiza cyane puwavuro yeze. Agahumyo kagira ibidomo byirabura bivamo amazi. Ibi bidomo biboneka kuri puwavuro ikiri mbisi niyeze. Aka gahumyo gakwirakwizwa n'imbuto zirwaye. Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya akaribata (Anthracnose) ko muri puwavuro; Gukoresha imbuto z'indobanure zitarwaye. Kugirira isuku umurima bavanamo ibisagazwa bya puwavuro nyuma y'isarura. Gukoresha umuti nka chlorothalonil 50 % wp (Garama 10 / L10 z'amazi.), cyangwa copper oxychloride 50 % wp (Garama 37 / L15 z'amazi).

Igihe cyiza cyo gusarura ibishyimbo ni iki: Isarura riba nyuma y'amezi 3, 4 cyangwa se 5 bitewe n'ubwoko bwahinzwe, Akarere ndetse n'ikirere, amababi amaze guhindura ibara akaba umuhondo agatangira guhunguka. Akenshi bitewe n'ubwoko, imisogwe ihindura ibara igasa na kaki. Iyo ibishyimbo byeze neza biba bifite igipimo cy'ubuherere buri hagati ya 15 na 18 %.

Ifumbire mvaruganda ni ifumbire ikorerwa mu ruganda iba irimo imyunyu y'ubutaka. Iyo myunyu iba mu mafumbire ishongeshwa vuba n'amazi bikivanga. Bityo uko igihingwa kivoma amazi kikayivomamo. Iyo amazi acengera kure mu butaka ajyana n'iyo myunyu. Ibihingwa ntibishobore kuyikoresha. Ni cyo bita “ kurigita kw'imyunyu y'ubutaka ' '. Iyo ibumba n'imborera bihagije mu butaka bifata amazi avanze n'iyo myunyu. Bityo iyo myunyu ikaguma hafi y'ubutaka.

Ibiranga Indwara y'ibihushi muri pome; Imbuto zafashwe zigira ibibara ku ruhu bimeze nk'amagaragamba afite ibara ry'igihogo bifite ishusho y'uruziga. Ku mababi usanga ariho byiganje cyane ku gice cyo hejuru cy'ikibabi. Igishishwa cy'imbuto kirasatagurika, ahasadutse hakabora. Uko warwanya Indwara y'ibihushi muri pome ni uku gukurikira; Gukoresha imiti yica uduhumyo nka Oxychlorure / hydroxide de cuivre, Metalaxyl, Mancozeb, Carbendazim; Ibipimo by'umuti bikoreshwa: - Carbendazim 500 g / L SC: 10 - 40ml / 20L, Iminsi yo gusarura nyuma yo gutera umuti (PHI): Iminsi 30. - Copper hydroxide 50 % WP: 40 - 60ml / 20L, PHI: Iminsi 14. - Mancozeb 80 % WP: 100gr / 20L, PHI: Iminsi 7 kugera 15. Kurumbura ubutaka bivuga kubuha ibyangombwa byose bituma bushobora gutunga igihingwa, hari ibikorwa by'ingenzi bikorwa mu kurumbura ubutaka aribyo: Kurwanya isuri, Kuvugurura ubutaka, ugabanya ubusharire utera ishwagara n'ifumbire y'imborera; Kongeraho kubuha myunyu ari byo bita gufumbira.

Gutera ifumbire mu cyayi: Ifumbire iterwa mu mirima ibagaye neza, yagomorewe neza, iterwa mu kwezi kwa 3 no mu kwa 10, iterwa ku muzenguruko wa buri giti cyangwa bakamisha iyo icyayi cyamaze gufatana.

Gukora ifumbire y'imborera ni ukurundira hamwe ibyatsi, ibibabi, uduti, ibisigazwa by'ibiribwa, iby'imbuto cyangwa se imboga kugirango bibora. Hari uburyo bwinshi bwo gukora ifumbire. Twavuga nko gucukura ingarane n'ubwo gukora kirundo cy'ifumbire ku butaka.

Ifumbire y'imborera ishyirwa mu murima igihe cy'ihinga. Ntigomba kwanikwa kugirango idatakaza imyunyu imwe n'imwe nka azote. Nyuma yo gutabira inyanyagizwa mu murima igaherako itabwa ikavangwa n'igitaka igihe cy'isanza. Hakenerwa toni kuva kuri 10 kugera kuri 20 kuri hegitari.

Iyo ugiye gukora ifumbire y'ikirundo ugomba kuba ufite ibyatsi bibora, ibisigazwa by'imyaka n'ibishingwe bihagije. Ikirundo kiba gifite nibura metero 1 mu bugari na metero 1 na sentimetero 20 z'ubuhagarike kandi gifite ishusho y'umutemeri. Ibizavamo ifumbire bigomba kubonerwa rimwe, bikarundwa ahantu hari igicucu mu nsi y'ibiti cg mu rutoke. Nyuma yo gusiza ahazakorerwa ifumbire, hakurikiraho gusasa ibisigazwa by'umusaruro, ibyatsi bibi, utwatsi, amababi y'ibiti n'ibihuru kugeza kuri sentimetero 15 - 20 z'ubuhagarike. Ibyo byose bibanza gucagagurwamo uduce duto duto kugirango bizabore vuba, kandi si byiza kubanza kubyanika. Hejuru hagerekwaho nibura sentimetero 5 z'ibibora neza nk'ifumbire y'amatungo, ibishishwa bya kawa cyangwa agataka karimo ifumire keza gatose. Bituma n'ibindi byose bibora. Hejuru hongerwaho sentimetero 20 z'ibindi byatsi, amababi y'ibiti. bicagaguye. Harenzwaho na none; ibibora sentimetero 5. Bigenda bigerekeranywa gutyo gutyo kugeza kirundo cyuzuye. Nyuma ikirundo kiratwikirwa kugirango kitumagara, bityo mikorobe ziboza ntizibone amazi yo kuzitunga ngo zikore akazi kazo. Si byiza kandi kurenzaho igitaka cyinshi cyangwa gutsindagira cyane kugirango izo mikorobe zitabura umwuka zihumeka. Ni ngombwa kugenzura ubushyuhe kuko ari bwo bwerekana ko mikorobe ziri gukora akazi kazo ko guhinduramo ibyatsi ifumbire. Ni ngombwa na none guhindura no kuvomera ikirundo ku rugero rukwiye kugirango kibone umwuka n'amazi udukoko dukeneye mu gucagagura ibyatsi o kuba cyaborera rimwe. Ifumbire y'imborera ikorwa neza ku buryo bworoshye mu gihe cy'imvura, kurushaho mu gihe cy'umuhindo. Ifumbire irushaho kubanziza iyo yongewemo ivuryo mu gikoni cyangwa ishwagara cg agafumbire mvaruganda gake. Gusa ibi si ngombwa cyane. Ifumbire nziza y'imbonerara iba yumutse, iseseka, kandi yirabura iri ku gipimo cya 1 / 5 cy'uburemere bw'ibyahereweho kuyikora (photo).

Iminsi: 112 - 119; Indwara ikingirwa: New Castle (ND) + infectious bronchitis (BI) + Egg - drop syndome (EDS) + coryza (ABC) salmonella Enteritidis; Inkingo: Cevac Corymune 7k; Uko zitangwa:

Inda z'icyayi: Red crevice mite ni udukoko duto dufite Ibara ry'Umutuku; Ibimenyetso bya Red crevice mite (Brevipalpus phoenicis) Amababi ahinduka ikigina ku ruhande rwayo rwo hasi Uko kiyongera amababi arahunguka; Kurwanya Red crevice mite (Brevipalpus phoenicis) Gukata no gukura mu mirima ibiti birwaye; Gutera umuti wabugenewe; Gutera Abamectin 1. 8 EC, Pyrethrum 5EW, Azadirachtin Indica;

Udutagangurirwa (Red spider mite) Ibitagangurirwa bitera amagi arenze 500 mu buzima bwabyo. Iyo bibaye byinshi ku gihingwa, amababi arangirika ndetse agahunguka. Imbuto zisa nabi ku ruhu kubera utu dusimba twirunzeho ari twinshi. Ibyatsi bibi n'ibisigazwa by'ibihingwa byafashwe n'udutagangurirwa nibyo bituma twikwirakwiza, bityo isuku mu murima ni ingenzi mu kurwanya utu dukoko. Gukoresha imiti nk'iyavuzwe haruguru nabyo birafasha.
Uburyo bwo kurwanya imbeba mu buhuniko bw'umuceriMu rwego rwo kwirinda imbeba mu buhunikiro hakoreshwa imitego (rwagakoco) cyangwa se bakazitegesha imiti (ibinini) yo kuzica.

Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya indwara y'Akaribata cyangwa Nyiragakecuru ni ub bu kurikira: Gutera amoko yihanganira indwara, Gutera imbuto itarwaye (yasaruwe ku misogwe itarwaye), Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu mirima. Guhungira imbuto mbere yo kuyitera hakoreshejwe imiti nka Benomyl hakoreshejwe garama ebyiri (2) ku kilo cy'imbuto.

● Amashu, borocoli na shufurere byera neza ahantu hadashyuha cyane (dogere 15 - 21) kandi byihanganira ubukonje. ● Byera neza mu butaka bw'umucanga n'inombe cyangwa inombe n'ibumba bufumbiye neza kandi buseseka, bufite igipimo cy'ubusharire (pH) kiri hagati 5. 5 na 6. 8. ● Mu Rwanda bihingwa cyane cyane mu majyaruguru ariko no mu bindi bice by'igihugu birahaboneka.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi mu ntoryi bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira; ● Intoryi zikunze kurwara indwara z'uduhumyo nk'akaribata; zirwanywa n'imiti usimburanya nka chlorothalonil (Daconil, odeon; 720SC), copper oxychloride (Gitenge), Carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim) na sulfur (Thiovit). ● Zinarwara kandi indwara za bagiteri (kirabiranya) zitagira umuti ahubwo zigomba kurindwa barandura ibyarwaye.

Kongera ifumbire mvaruganda kuri kurujete myuma yo gutera bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Kongeraho ifumbire mvaruganda: Nyuma y'iminsi 15 umaze gutera (kugemura), ongera ushyireho ifumbire mvaruganda ya NPK 17 - 17 - 17 (garama 20) ni ukuvuga udufuniko tubiri twi ' icupa ry'amazi y'Inyange ku muzenguruko aho imizi igarukira, urenzeho agataka (Hakoreshwa kg 2 kuri ari). Icyitonderwa: Igihe kurujete zitereweho mu murima zitanyujijiwe mu bihoho, zihabwa ifumbire mvaruganda kuburyo bukurikira: Garama 20 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 / ku mwobo ku munsi wo gutera, Garama 20 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 ku minsi 30 nyuma yo gutera; Nyuma y'ukwezi kumwe uteye / ugemuye ongera na none ushyireho ifumbire mvaruganda ya NPK 17 - 17 - 17 (garama 10), ukoresheje agafuniko kamwe k'icupa ry'amazi y'inyange ku muzenguruko aho imizi igarukira, urenzeho agataka.
Soya ikunda ubutaka bw'isi ndende bufite ifumbire ihagije kandi butuma umwuka ubutemberamo.

Inyongeramusaruro zikenewe ku guhinga ari imwe y'inyanya n'ingano yazo: K ' umurima ungana na ari imwe, hakoreshwa imbuto zingana na garama 2, ifumbire y'imborera y'ibiro 250, ifumbire ya NPK 17. 17. 17 ingana n'ibiro 3, ifumbire ya Ire ibiro 1. 3 kugira ngo umusaruro ube mwiza, hakaba hakenewe ingemwe zigera kuri 270.

Inyongeramusaruro zikenewe kuri ari imwe n'ingano yazo mu guhinga watermelon nizi zikurikira: Ingano y'umurama: garama 5; Imborera: ibiro 250; Ifumbire ya NPK: ibiro 3 n'igice; Ifumbire ya Ire: garama 650; Umubare w'Ingemwe:

Kwita kugihingwa cya watermelon bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Gusasira: Ni ngombwa gusasira watameroni hakoreshwa ibyatsi byumye neza. Kuvomerera: Nyuma yo gutera ni ngombwa guhita bavomerera. Irinde gutosa amababi kugirango hatabaho kororoka kwihuse kw'indwara ziterwa n'uduhumyo. Kubagara: Kubagara bikorwa igihe cyose ibyatsi bibi bigaragara mu murima. Kongeramo ifumbire y'imvaruganda: kuri buri rugemwe bongeraho garama 35 cyangwa udufuniko dutatu n'igice tw'icupa ry'amazi za NPK 17 17 17 nyuma y'iminsi 30 bateye na garama 13 cyangwa agafuniko kuzuye k'icupa ry'amazi za Urea nyuma y'iminsi 60 bateye. Iyi fumbire ishyirwa ku muzenguruko w'urugemwe aho imizi igarukira. Kwicira umugozi: Kugirango watameroni igire imigozi myiza izeraho ibihaza, ni ngombwa guca umutwe w'umumero nyuma y'amababi 6. Ibi bituma hashibuka amashami maze umuhinzi agahitamo amashami 4 meza. Kuri aya mashami 4, ni byiza ko rimwe ridaheka ibihaza kugirango rizatunge ayandi.

uburyo inyagazi z'ingurube zigaburirwa ni ubu bukurikira: Inyagazi ihaka, kuva ku munsi wa 8 igabanyirizwa ibyo yaryaga bikagera ku biro 2 ku munsi. Ingurube ihaka ntikenera ibiribwa byinshi kuko iraremera cyane kandi ibike irya ibikoresha neza. Ikindi nuko ingurube yabyibushye cyane inanirwa kubyara bityo abana bayo bagapfa bavuka. Iyo ishigaje iminsi 3 ngo ibyare, umworozi ayigabanyiriza ibiryo kugeza ku kiro kimwe ku munsi. Umunsi iri bubyare ntacyo inyagazi igomba kurya. Muriicyo gihe cyose igomba kubona amazi ahagije. Ingurube yabyaye: mu minsi ibiri ya mbere imaze kubyara irya bike ikiro kimwe, ikannywa amazi menshi. Hanyuma igipimo kigenda kiyongera buhororo buhoro hakurikije uko irya n'umubare w'ibibwana yabyaye. Nyuma y'icyumweru kimwe iba irya ibiryo bikubyemo inshuro ebyiri n'igice kugeza inshuro eshati y'ibyo yaryaga mbere. Ishobora kurya hagati y; ibiro 5 na 7, 5 bitewe n'umubare w'ibibwana yonsa. Iyo ndyo igaburwa 3 ku munsi. Amazi akomeza gutangwa menshi. Hagomba buri gihe kubamo inyongera y'imyunyu. Ibyo byose bituma inyagazi ibona amagurubegurube menshi kandi ntigandare kubera konsa cyane. Inyagazi iri bucutse mu gitondo, ntigaburirwa ni mugoroba, bayima n'amazi. Umunsi wa mbere icukije ihabwa ikiro kimwe cy'ibiryo umunsi wa 2 nuwa 3 ihabwa ibiro 2 ku munsi. Kuva ku munsi wa 4 kugeza yimye ikanageza umunsi wa 8 ihabwa hagati y'ibiro 2, 5 na 3 by'ibiryo n'inyongera y'imyunyu. Inyongera y'indyo n'imyunyu ituma ingurubeyongera umubare w'abana izabyara.
Iminsi: 91; Indwara ikingirwa: New Castle (ND) + infectious bronchitis BI (Variant) Inkingo: CAVAC NEWL + CEVAC Ibird; Uko zitangwa:

ibyo wakorera ikiraro ugiye kwimura cg gusazura inkoko; Kuramo isaso n'ibikoresho byose wakoresha kukiciro cyambere; Sukura inzu n'ibikoresho byakoreshwaga ukoresha umuti wica udukoko; Sukura ikiraro nkuko wabikoze ugiye kugishyiramo inkoko; Kureka inzu ikamara byibura ibyumweru 2 mbere yo gushyiramo izindi. Icyitonderwa: Umworozi wahuye n'ikibazo cy'icyorezo asukura ikiraro nk'uko byavuzwe akazanamo izindi nkoko agendeye kumabwiriza yahawe n'abavuzi b'amatungo.

Urumuri mu bworozi bw'inkoko zitera amagi ni ngombwa cyane. Gusa hari aho biba ngombwa ko ingano cyangwa se amasaha asabwa y'urumuri ku munsi aterwa n'ubwoko bw'inkoko woroye. Urumuri mu bworozi bw'inkoko zitera amagi rugenda ruhinduka bitewe n'ikigero cy'ubukure inkoko zigezemo. Byibuze ku munsi wa mbere imishwi iba ikeneye urumuri amasaha 24 / 24. Ku cyumweru cyambere n'icya kabiri imishwi iba ikeneye urumuri byibuze rungana n'amasaha 23 / 24. Icyumweru cya gatatu imishwi iba ikene urumuri rungana n'amasaha 20 / 24, uru rumuri rugenda ruhinduka kugeza aho rugera ku masaha 16 / 24 ku munsi mugihe byibuze 5 % y'inkoko itangiye gutera amagi. Urumuri ni kimwe mu bituma inkoko zirya cyane (amasaha menshi) zigakura vuba kandi zigatanga umusaruro mugihe gito cyane. Aha tubibutse ko inkoko zitaweho neza zishobora gutangira gutera amagi mugihe cy'iminsi 126, aha; bivugwa ko byibuze buri nkoko iba imaze kurya ibiro 7 by'ibiryo (7kg).

Gukora ifumbire y'imborera ukoresheje iminyorogoto ni ubundi buryo bukoreshwa mu kubona ifumbire y'imborera. Iyi fumbire ikorwa n'iminyorogoto ishangura imyanda yaba iyo mu gikoni mu mirima mu bimpoteri mu nganda n'ahandi mu buryo bwihuse. Iyi minyorogoto ikurira neza ahantu hatumagaye / hadakakaye ariko nanone hatajandamye, hatari ibiryo bihiye n'inyama, hatari n'urumuri rwinshi. Ubu buryo bwo gulora ifumbire nibwiza cyane kuko usanga aho ikorerwa nta munuko changwa amasazi ahari. Ikindi ni uko iyo minyorogoto idashobora kugira ahandi ijya uretse muri icyo gisanduku. Iyi fumbire usanga imeze nk'itaka yarashangutse neza. Uko bikorwa; Hakoreshwa igisanduku gihagaze ku maguru ane. Indiba yacyo ni ibati (kureza amazi ava mw'ifumbire nayo; agakoreshwa nk'ifumbire y'amazi). Gushyiraho umureko wo kuyobora umushongi mw'ijerikani. Gushyiramo isaso (ibikarito, impapuro, …) Kuzana iminyorogoto ikiri mw'ifumbire yayo ukayinyanyagiza kuri ya saso. Kongeraho ibigaburirwa (ibikonko, ibishishwa byo mu gikoni, ….) Bigomba kuba bihehereye. Gutwikira na shitingi y'umukara.

Rero ifumbire mvaruganda igira akamaro iyo ikoreshejwe ku butaka bufite imiterere myiza, bukize ku mborera. Iyo ikoreshejwe yonyine ari nyinshi, cyane cyane ikize mu myunyu nka azote, ituma mikorobi z'ubutaka ziyongera vuba vuba. Bityo zikanyunyuza imborera yose kandi ari yo ituma ubutaka bwegerana. Iyo irangiye, za mikorobi zirapfa n'ubutaka bugasigara bumeze nk'ivumbi ku buryo n'imizi ishobora kubura aho ifata. Icyo gihe ubutaka bubura ubuzima bukagunduka. Isuri na yo ishobora kuririraho kuko ubutaka buba butagifatanye. Ni ngombwa rero kwirinda kurenza urugero rw'ifumbire mvaruganda yo gukoresha no kwirinda kuyikoresha yonyine.

Akamaro ko gutera ibigori ku mirongo ni aka gakurikira: Gukoresha imbuto ibazwe kandi ijyanye n'ubuso bwo gutera; Bituma ibihingwa bitarwanira imirasire y'izuba n'imyunyu ngugu iri mu butaka; Bituma hasigara umwanya wo gukoreramo imirimo itandukanye nko kubagara, kuhira, gutera imiti no kongera mo ire.

Indwarea ya kanyugunyugu irwanywa mu buryo bukurikira: Kumisha neza ibigori umaze kubisarura kuburyo ugera ku buhehere mu mpeke buri hagati ya 12 % na 14 %; Guhunika umusaruro ahantu habugenewe, hafite isuku, nta mpeke z'ibigori zindi cyangwe se impeke z'ibindi bihingwa zihari, nta mukungu, umusenyi n'ibindi byose bishobora gutea umwanda; Gukuraho ibyatsi byaba biri hafi y'ubuhunikiro; Buri cyumweru kugeza ku byumweru bibiri, gusura ubuhunikiro, ukareba niba na twenge turi ku mpeke; Gukoresha imiti yica udusimba two mu buhunikiro kandi ukurikiza amabwiriza yose aba ari kumwe n'umuti wahisemo. Imwe mu muti wakoresha yemewe mu Rwanda ni iyi: Malathion 2 % w / w, Dust; Malathion 2. 0 % w / w + Permethrin 0. 3 % w / w; Profenofos, 40 % EC; 50 % EC; Pyrethrins, 75 % w / w EC; Pyrimiphos - Methyl 400g / l + 75g / l Permethrin, EC;
Ingano ni igihingwa gikunda ubutaka bw'isi ndende bufite ifumbire y'imborera ihagije kandi buhitisha amazi.

Indwara y'umugese w'umuhondo mu ngano yirindwa mu buryo bukurikira: Gutera ingano zihanganira iyi indwara kandi kare; Kurandura ingano za kimeza ziboneka hagati y'ibihembwe by'ihinga; Gusimburanya ingano n'ibindi bihingwa; Gutera umwe mu miti ikurikira: Tebuconazole nka Orius: miligarama 30 muri Litiro 20 z'amazi; Copper Oxychloride (Nordox, Funguran): garama 30 muri Litiro 20 z'amazi.
Mu gufata neza umuceri mu mirima, mu mirimo y'ingenzi harimo kubagara inshuro 2 cyangwa 3, gutera umuti wica udukoko nuwo kurwanya indwara, kuhira no gukamura amazi igihe ari ngombwa.

Imbuto y'ibishyimbo ijya kuri hegitari n'intera hagati y'izo mbuto z'ibishyimbo uko ingana: Batera ibiro mirongo ine (40 kg) kugeza ku biro mirongo irindwi (70 kg) z'imbuto kuri hegitari (Ha) bitewe n'uburemere bw'intete. Gutera ni kuri santimetero mirongo ine (Cm 40) cgse mirongo itanu (cm 50) hagati y'imirongo na santimetero makumyabiri (cm20) ku mirongo bashyira intete ebyili (2) mu kobo.

Iyi ndwara iterwa n'agahumyo yibasira amababi n'imbuto bikiri bito. Iyo imbuto zirengeje amezi abiri ziba zibasha kudafatwa n'iyi ndwara. Ikirere gifite ubushyuhe buri hagati ya dogire (OC) 3. 5 - 27 n'ubutote bw'amababi mu gihe cy'amasaha 12 - 24 nibyo bituma ubu burwayi bubaho kandi bukwirakwizwa n'abantu, imvura, umuyaga, udusimba, ibikoresho, ingemwe n'imbuto birwaye.  Ibimenyetso by'iyi ndwara n'uko yangiza; Udusununu duto tw'ibara ry'igihogo ricyeye cyangwa amaga bigaragara ku mababi, amashami n'imbuto. Iyo amaga amaze igihe, aho ari haba hahanda ndetse hagasatagurika. Amababi aragwingira, akikunja, akamera nk'afite amenyo ku muzenguruko wayo.  Uko wayirinda; Gutegurira pepiniyeri ahantu hategereye umurima w'ibinyamacunga ufite ubu burwayi; Gutera ingemwe zidafite uburwayi; Kwirinda kuvomerera amazi aca hejuru mu mashami y'igiti; Gukonorera buri gihe kugirango urumuri n'umwuka bibashe gutembera neza mu mashami no kuvanaho amashami yumye kuko ashobora kuba abitse ubu burwayi.  Uko wayirwanya; Gutera imiti yica uduhumyo: Gusimburanya imiti irimo copper (Oxychlorure de cuivre, Oxide de cuivre, Hydroxide de cuivre), chlorothalonil (Daconil), carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim) na tricyclazole (beam) Umuti uterwa gusa ku biti byigeze kugaragaza ubu burwayi.

Utumatirizi ni udusimba tuboneka rimwe na rimwe ku binyamacunga ariko tukaba twangiza cyane ndetse biragoye kuturwanya. Dukunda ikirere gihehereye. Tubasha gukwirakwizwa no kugenda ubwatwo tuva kugiti kimwe tujya kukindi, umuyaga, mu maguru y'inyoni, ku bikoresho byo mumurima n'abantu. Nyuma yo guturagwa, utu dusimba tuba ari umuhondo werurutse ariko duhita dusohora umushongi w'umweru udutwikira. Tuboneka ku bihingwa byinshi bitandukanye kandi twororoka vuba.  Uko Utumatirizi (citrus mealybugs) tw'amacunga, mandarine n'indimu twangiza; Utumatirizi tunyunyuza amatembabuzi y'igihingwa bigatuma igihingwa gikura nabi n'imbuto zikaba zahunguka; Utu dusimba kandi twanduza amababi n'amashami y'igihingwa bitewe natwo ubwatwo cyangwa umushongi twituma ukurura uruhumbu rubangamira igihingwa. Gukonorera bituma amashami adapfukirana bityo umuti wica udusimba waterwa ukabasha kugera ahantu hose; Kugabanya uburebure bw'amashami kugirango adakoranaho bituma ibiti bifite utumatirizi bitanduza ibitadufite; Gusukura neza ibikoresho byakoreshejwe mu murima urwaye kugirango bidakwirakwiza utumarizi tuvuye mu murima urwaye tujya kubiti bizima; Ibimonyo bigomba kurwanwa kugirango inshuti z'abahinzi zibashe gukora akazi kazo ko kurwanya utumatirizi. Iyo vese (Vicia sp) iteye mu murima w'ibinyamacunga ikurura ibimonyo bikava aho utumatutizi turi.  Uko tumatirizi (citrus mealybugs) tw'amacunga, mandarine n'indimubaturwanya; Gutera imiti nka Abamectine [Dudu acelamectine, Romectine], Acetameprid [Aster extreme]. Icyitonderwa: imiti ntakamaro igira iyo itewe ku giti gifite amashami yapfukiranye kubera kudakonora.

Kwita ku buhumbikiro bw'intoryi bikorwa mu butyo bukurikira: Nyuma yo kwinaza, shyiraho isaso y'ibyatsi byumye neza. Kuraho isaso nyuma y'iminsi 7 kugeza ku 10 ingemwe zimaze kumera. Ubakira ubuhumbikiro unabutwikire bityo birinde ingemwe kwicwa n'izuba. Wibuke gusiga aho imirasire y'izuba inyura kuko ingemwe ziba zirikeneye. Vomerera buri munsi mu gitondo kare no kumugoroba. Icira ingemwe igihe zicucitse. Tera imiti irwanya indwara (mancozeb cyangwa methalaxyl) n'irwanya ibyonnyi (Lambda - Cyhalothrin) bibaye ngombwa. Gabanya igihe cyo kuvomerera kandi ugende ugabanya igicucu cy'ubuhumbikiro mu gihe cy'icyumweru 1 cyangwa 2 mbere yo kugemura kugirango ingemwe zikomere. Tera ingemwe mu murima hashize iminsi 30 - 60 nyuma yo kwinaza (zifite amababi 3 - 4).

Hitamo umurima udaheruka guhingwamo ibimera biri mu muryango mugari umwe na dodo / imbwija nka beterave na sipinaci n'ibindi mu gihembwe cy'ihinga giheruka. Hinga neza ugeza isuka mu butaka ku bujyakuzimu bwa cm 30 kugira ngo bifashe kuringaniza ubutaka neza, guhitisha umwuka no gushora imizi. Menagura ibinonko byose ukuramo amabuye n'ibyatsi byose. Niba uhita utera mu murima, shyira ifumbire y'imborera ingana na toni 25, n'ifumbire mvaruganda ingana na kg 147 bya NPK17 - 17 - 17 + kg 33 za ire kuri hegitari mu gihe cyo gutera.

Amagweja aturagwa mu magi y'ikinyugunyugu (BOMBIX MORI L.): Nyuma y'iminsi 6 - 10 aturazwe, amagweja agaburirwa 4 ku munsi ku manywa na n'ijoro. Amagweja yororerwa mu nzu yabugenewe ifite ubushyuhe buri hagati ya 23 - 28 dogere serisiyusi, ubuhehere buri hagati ya 70 - 90 %, idashobora kwinjirwamo n'imbeba, umuswa, ibintu binuka nk'umwotsi, imiti yica udukoko n'amavuta ahumura yo kwisiga.

ifumbire ya rizobiyumu ikoreshwa mu buryo bukurikira: Minjira utuzi dukeya ku mbuto ugiye gutera, Vanga garama 80 za rizobiyumu muri biro 8 kugeza 10 by'imbuto. Imbuto yavanzwe na Rhizobium ntishyirwa ku zuba kandi iterwa uwo munsi ikarangira. Mu gihe cyo gutera shyira buri rubuto kuri santimetero 5 kugeza 10 mu gaferege hanyuma uhite utwikirizaho itaka.

Dore ibisobanuro ku ndwara y'ububembe bw'imyumbati: Indwara y'ububembe bw'imyumbati iterwa na virusi. IBIMENYETSO BY ' INDWARA Y ' UBUBEMBE BW ' IMYUMBATI; Iyi ndwara igitangira ikibabi kigaragaza amabara y'umuhondo avanze n'icyatsi kibisi. Uko indwara irushaho gukara amababi ata ireme akihinahina, kandi akaba matoya cyane; Iyo indwara ikabije umwumbati ukura nabi, ukagwingira amababi ntabe akigaragara uhereye ku mutwe w'umwumbati. Iyo uteye ingeri irwaye ntabwo ishora. Iyo ifashwe yarashoye ntabwo yera neza; umusaruro ugabanuka bitewe n'ikigero yari igezemo n'ubukana bw'indwara. Uburyo INDWARA Y ' UBUBEMBE bw'imyumbati ikwirakwira; Gutera ingeri z'imyumbati zivuye ku giti kirwaye; Udusazi duto tw'umweru nitwo dukwirakwiza iyi ndwara; Ibikoresho byifashishwa mu gutegura imbuto no gusarura; Uburyo bwo kwirinda ko kurwanya indwara y'ububembe bw'imyumbati; Gutera ubwoko bw'imyumbati bwihanganira indwara y'ububembe. Gutera ingeri zitarwaye zavuye mu mirima yakurikiranywe n'inzego zibishinzwe. Gusura umurima w'imyumbati kenshi nibura rimwe mu kwezi cg mu mezi atatu, iyabembye ikarandurwa. Kurandura imyumbati yose irwaye. Gukoresha ibikoresho bitakoreshejwe mu mirima irwaye cyangwa byacishijwe ku muriro mu gihe cy'iminota 2 cyangwa byogejwe muri JIK (mililitiro 750ml muri litiro 15 z'amazi).

Gutera ingemwe z'urusenda bikorwa gutya: Umurima uhingwa neza ku bujyakuzimu bwa santimentero 30. Vomerera ingemwe mbere yo kuzitera uzitere mu gitondo kare; Urusenda ruterwa ku ntera ya santimentero 60 hagati y'imirongo na santimentero 45 mu murongo. Cukura imyobo y'ubujyakuzimu bwa santimentero 15. Mumwobo umwe hajyamo ifumbire y'imborera yuzuye amashyin ' agafuniko k'icupa ry'amazi kuzuye NPK 17 - 17 - 17. Shyira KCL agafuniko ka fanta kuzuye neza mu myobo ine mu gihe cyo gutera.

Gutera ingemwe mu buhumbikiro bw'ibitunguru bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Ubuhumbikiro bushyirwa ahantu hatigeze hahingwa ibihingwa byo mu muryango umwe n'ibitunguru nka tungurusumu, n'ibindi nibura mu bihembwe cy'ihinga gishize. Ubuso bw'ubuhumbikiro bugomba kuba 4 % by'umurima wose uzaterwamo. Mbese metero kare enye ku murima wa Ari imwe. Hategurwa ubuhumbikiro bufite ubugali bwa metero imwe kugeza kuri metero 1 na sentimetero makunyabiri n'ubujyejuru bwa sentimetero 20 kugirango amazi abashe gusohoka mu butaka. Vanga amashyi atatu y'imborera iboze neza ibiro 35 n'ubutaka bwo hejuru: amashyi atatu yuzuye ibiro 3 kugera 5 kuri metero kare imwe, na garama 20 za NPK 17 17 17zingana n'udufuniko 2 tw'icupa ry'amazi icyumweru kimwe mbere yo guhumbika; Igihe cyo kwinaza, ringaniza ubutaka, uce imirongo yo kwinazamo ifite ubujyakuzimu bw'igice cya sentimetero kandi itandukanijwe na sentimetero 5. Umurama ushyirwa muri ya mirongo yaciwe ku ntera ya sentimetero 1 hagati y'imbuto; hanyuma hakarenzwaho agataka gacye bagatsindagira gahoro.

Kwita kugihingwa cy'ibitunguru bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Gusasira: bikorwa mbere cyangwa nyuma yo gutera. Kuvomerera: Bikorwa ukimara gutera bigakomeza igihe cyose ari ngombwa. Irinde gutosa amababi kugirango uburwayi butabona aho bwororokera. Kongeraho Ire: Nyuma y'ibyumweru 6 uteye, shyiramo ifumbire ya Ire ingana na kg 1. 5 kuri ari (agafuniko kamwe ka fanta ku murongo wa metero imwe). Kubagara: Bi bikorwa igihe cyose ari ngombwa kandi ukaboneraho gusukira wegereza itaka ku bitunguru. Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi.

Ibiranga Indwara y'Umugese mu bitunguru; Iyi ndwara igaragara cyane igihe cy'ubuhehere bwinshi buvanze n'ubushyuhe buringaniye cyangwa buke. Iyi ndwara ifata kumababi ikarangwa n'ibidomo bifite ifu ifite ibara rishyira umutuku cyangwa orange nyuma bikaba umukara. Amababi yafashwe cyane ahinduka umuhondo nyuma agahita yuma atarakura bityo bigatuma umusaruro ugabanuka. Uko birinda Indwara y'Umugese mu bitunguru; Gutera ku mitabo, Kudacucika ibitunguru igihe cyo gutera, Gusimburanya ibihingwa, Kuvana mu murima ibisigazwa by'ibihingwa, Kwirinda gufumbiza azote irengije ikigero cyagenwe; Uko bavura Indwara y'Umugese mu bitunguru; Gukoresha imiti irimo copper nka Copper oxychloride cyangwa Copper Oxide ku gipimo cya 37.

ingemwe za watermelon ziterwa mu buryo bukurikira: Hinga neza ku bujyakuzimubwa sentimetero 30, Ringaniza, Kuramo amabuye n'ibyatsi byose. Cukura imyobo ingana na sentimetero 30 z'umurambararo na sentimetero 30 z'ubujyakuzimu ku ntera ya metero 2 kuri metero 1. Shyira muri buri mwobo ibiro bitanu by'imborera cyangwa amashyi 5, na garama 35 za NPK 17 17 17 cyangwa udufuniko dutatu n'igice tw'agacupa k'amazi. Ifumbire ivangwa neza n'itaka. Kura ingemwe mu bihoho maze uzitere mu myobo yateguwe witonze ku buryo itaka ryo ku mizi rigumaho.

Gutera Imiteja bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Sekera mbere y'ibyumweru bibiri imvura itaragwa, usanze neza mu gihe cy'itera. Koresha buri gihe imbuto yujuje ubuziranenge ipakiye mu gapaki keza, ivuye ku mucuruzi wizewe, ifite ubwiza kandi ikihanganira indwara. Gucukura uduferegedufite ubbujyakuzimu bwa sentmetero 10 kandi dutandukanijwe na sentimetero 40. Shyira muri buri gaferege imborera iboneze neza. Hakoreshwa amashyi yuzuye neza ku murongo wa metero imwe. Ongeraho DAP yuzuye agafuniko kamwe ka Fanta kuzuye cyane ku murongo wa metero imwe DAP ijya kuri ari imwe ni ikiro kimwe na garama 600 kg. Ongeraho DAP yuzuye agafuniko kamwe ka Fanta kuzuye cyane ku murongo wa metero imwe DAP Ijya kuri ari imwe ni ikiro kimwe na garama 300 kg. Shyira intete mu gaferege ku ntera ya sentimetero 10. Twikira neza n'itaka kuburyo utamenya aho agaferege kari gacukuye.

Ingemwe za avoka zo gutera zitegurwa mu buryo bukurikira: Habanza gutoranya ibiti bifite avoka zeze neza kandi zidafite indwara. Ibibitu bikurwa muri avoka zihanuwe ku biti: si byiza gukoresha ibibuto byatoraguwe kuko biba bifite uburwayi. Guhumbika bikorerwa mu butaka bwiza, buseseka, burimo ifumbire ihagije, kandi butari mu gishanga. Ubuhumbikiro burubakirwa, bugasakarwa, bagatera ibibuto mu mirongo. Umurongo n'undi itandukanwa na santimetero 10, mu murongo ibibuto biba byegeranye, twikirizaho agataka gake n'utwatsi duke hanyuma bikavomererwa kenshimigihe cyose imvura itagwa. Nyuma y'ukwezi n'igice kugeza kuri abiri, ibibuto biri mu buhumbikiro biba bimaze kumera. Icyo gihe umumero uba ureshya na santimetero 5 kugera ku 10 kandi uba ugifashe ku bibuto. Urandura ikibuto cyameze, ugakata umuzi kuri santimetero 3 kugera kuri 5 uvuye ku kibuto kugirango izamereho indi mizi, ukagishyira mu gihoho cya plastiki gipfumaguye cyuzuye igitaka rivanze n'ifumbire. Bakoresha ibihoho bya santimetero 20 kuri 20, kuko bifata umwanya muto muri pepiniyeri kandi bikagabanya akazi. Ibihoho biterekwa ku murongo, muri pepiniyeri itwikiriye. Ingemwe zitabwaho, uvomerera iyo imvura itaguye.

Amababi y'icyayi yasoromwe agomba gufatwa neza nta kuyanyukanyuka no kuyapfunyarika mu ntoki, asoromerwa mu gitebo cyabugenewe kiba kiri mu mugongow ' umusoromyi ntatsindagirwe kuko iyo atsindagiwe cyangwa anyukanyutswe arangirika agatangira gushya. Umusoromyi yihutira gutwara icyayi ku kirogotero gifite isuku (collection center) aho gipimirwa uburemere ndetseiyo gisoromye nabi arongera akagitoranyamo ibisoromye nabi aribyo bita kurogota, iyo umusoromyi amaze gupimirwa icyayi yihutira kugisuka hasi akagisanza kugirango kidashyuhirana kigashya, imodoka zikihutira kuza kugipakira zikijyana ku ruganda rugitunganya. Imodoka zitwara icyayi zigomba kuba zifite isuku, zikaba zirimo ibitanda biterekwaho amakirete (cretes) apakiyemo icyayi kidatsindagiye gifite ubuhumekero cyangwa se zikabamo utwuma tumanikwaho imifuka (crochets) ipakiyemo icyayi kidatsindagiye gifite ubuhumekero. Imodoka zigomba kuza gutwara icyayi zidakerererewe, ababishinzwe bose bagomba gufatanya gupanga uko imodoka zijya gupakira byihuse, abazipakira n'abazipakurura n'aho zipakururirwa bigategurwa kugirango icyayi kidapfira mu birogotero cyangwa mu nzira cyangwa ku ruganda aho zitegerereza gupakururwa ngo icyayi gitunganywe. Imihanda (feeder roads) igomba kuba ikoze neza kugirango imodoka zitanainrwa kunyuramo icyayi kigakererwa kigapfa.

Indwara y'ibidomo by'ibijuju mu cyayi: Ikiyitera: Pestalotia theae; Ibimenyetso by'indwara y'ibidomo by'ibijuju mu cyayi; Ibizinga bya “ grey ” ku mababi akuze; Utudomo tw'umukara muri ibyo bizinga ku ruhande rwo hejuru rw'ikibabi; Kwirinda indwara y'ibidomo by'ibijuju; Kudakora igicucu gikabije mu ma pepiniyeri; Kutarenza amababi akenewe mu gihe cyo kuvomerera imbuto muri pepiniyeri; Gutera ifumbire uko bigomba; Kuvura indwara y'ibidomo by'ibijuju; Kugabanya igicucu; Kugabanya kuvomerera; Imiti ikoreshwa: Dithane M45 garama 4 - 5 / litiro 1 y'amazi), copper oxychloride garama 7 litiro ime y'amazi, Benlate garama 1 muri litiro imwe y'amazi.

Ikiraro cy'inka: Ikiraro gituma umworozi yongera umusaruro ukomoka ku matungo nk'amata, inyama, ifumbire n'imirimo. Gukingira amatungo ibihe bibi biturutse ku kirere nk'ubushyuhe, izuba n'ibindi; Gucunga neza amatungo, kuyagaburira neza no kwita ku buvuzi bwayo; Koroshya uburyo bwo gufata umusaroro w'ubworozi bw'inka: Amata n'ifumbire; Kongera umusaruro uyaturukaho, gutanga ifumbire no kugabanya abakozi.

Ikigero cy'inka zifatwa Indwara y'Ubutaka: Inyana, inka nkuru; Ibimenyetso by'indwara y'Ubutaka (Anthrax) mu nka; Izafashwe akenshi zipfa ako kanya nta bimenyetso by'indwara byigaragaje; Kugira umurimo mwinshi dogere 40 na 41°C, guhinda umushyitsi, kutarisha, umutima utera cyane, ingorane mu guhume - ka, inyama zisa n'izababutse, guhitwa amaraso, kuganga amaraso;

Uburyo bwo kurwanya inzoka zo mu ngurube ni ubu bukurikira: Inyagazi: Iminsi 15 mbere yuko inyagazi zibyara, kuziha umuti bwa mbere, Umunsi ukurikiraho, gukuramo amabyi, koza aho ziri; Iminsi 3 mbere yuko zibyara, kuziha umuti w'izoka ubwa kabiri; Umunsi umwe mbere yuko zibyara, koza neza inyagazi no gusukura inzu. Abana b'ingurube: Iyo ibyo bakorerea inyagazi byakurikijwe neza, nta muti w'inzoka abana bakenera mbere yuko bacuka; Ingurube zibyibushywa: Iminsi 2 cyangwa nyuma yo gucuka, kuziha kuziha umuti w'inzoka bwa mbere. Gusukura nyuma y'iminsi 2; Nyuma y'iminsi 14, kuziha umuti w'inzoka ubwa kabiri; Gusukura.

Indyo igaburwa kabiri ku munsi; bitarenze saa tatu hatangwa igice cya mbere, igice cya kabiri gitangwa saa cyenda, bitarenga saa kumi.

Umusaruro w'ihene: Isekurume ikuze ishobora gupima kg 40, inyagazi igapima kg 30 (ihene za kinyarwanda). Iyo ihene ibazwe itanga inyama zingana na 48 % z'ibiro byayo ari nzima. Ihene 3 zororewe mu kiraro zishobora gutanga toni 2 z'ifumbire ku mwaka.

Umusaruro w'inzuki: Mu turere inzuki zeramo neza, umuzinga wa kijyambere w'ubwoko bya Langstroth ushobora kwera kg 50 kugera kuri 70 z'ubuki, naho uwa gihanga ukera kugera kuri kg 10 gusa.

Ibuka gusukura inkuta nogukuramo ibitagangurirwa; Sukura inzu n'ibikoresho nyuma ukoreshe umuti wica udukoko; wabigenewe; Siga ishwagara ikiraro cy'inkoko hasi no ku nkuta byibuze metero imwe uvuye hasi; Tegereza nibura iminsi ibiri humuke maze ushyiremo isaso yumutse; Shyiramo isaso ikwiranye n'ubuso bwose bw'ikiraro nibura k'umubyimba wa santimetero eshanu (5cm) Isaso igomba guterwa umuti wica udukoko; Funga neza ikiraro cyawe utegereze ibyumweru bibiri mbere yo gushyiramo inkoko.
