Ubutabazi bw'ibanze: Mu gihe ugitegereje umuganga w'amatungo nibyiza kuziha amavitamine, imyunyungugu, amazi meza n'indyo yuzuye no kuzitaho.
Mbere yo kujya mu nzu y'inkoko, umuntu wese agomba kwambara imyenda yabugenewe ndetse agakandagira mumuti wica udukoko.

Uburyo bwo gukumira no kurinda indwara mu bworozi bw'inkoko; Isuku igomba kuboneka: Aho bororera, Ibyo bagaburiramo n'ibyo zinyweramo amazi n'ibindi bikoresho; Ubwirinzi ni uburyo bwose bukoreshwa kugira ngo hirindwe udukoko dutera indwara kugera aho inkoko zororewe. Ubworozi butarangwamo indwara bugabanya impfu z'inkoko zorowe mu kiraro ndetse n'ibihombo biturutse mu gukoresha imiti bitari ngombwa. Inkoko zifite ubuzima buzira umuze zitanga umusaruro ndetse n'umworozi akabona inyungu ishimishije. Ku bw'umwihariko, kugira ngo hirindwe udukoko dutera uburwayi mu bworozi bw'inkoko, ni ngombwa ko hubahirizwa ibintu bikurikira: Abakozi bakora mu biraro n'abashyitsi bose bagomba gukaraba intoki bakoresheje isabune mbere yo kwinjira mu biraro. Bagomba kubanza kubanza kwisukura bakoresheje imiti yica ubukoko butera indwara mbere yo kwinjira mu biraro. ndetse bagomba no kwambara imyenda y'isuku yabugenewe urugero: bote, isurubeti, agapfukamunwa, akanozasuku, n'udupfukantoki.

Isarubeti; Agapfukamunywa; Akanozasuku; Akazenga k'umuti; Bote; Uturindasuku; Ipondo; Ibinyabutabire bikoreshwa mu kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ry'indwara mu nkoko; Zimwe mu ngero z'ibinyabutabire bikoreshwa mu kwirinda ikwirakwizwa ry'indwara: Alukole; Kleoline; D4; Ishwagara y'ifu; N ' ibindi. Umworozi yakwegera ahacurizwa imiti y'amatungo bakamufasha.

Mu cyumweru cya mbere, imishwi 150 iba ikeneye igikosho kimwe inyweramo amazi (Drinker), iyo kurugero woroye imishwi 1000, uba ukeneye byibuze ibikoresho byo kunyweramo amazi 15. Kuva kucyumweru cya kabiri ugomba kongeramo ibindi bikoresho 5, mu cyumweru cya gatatu wongeramo ibindi bikoresho 5 inkoko zinyweramo, ugakomeza kugeza ku cyumweru cya kane aho inkoko 1000 zizabazikenyeye ibikoresho zinywera mo amazi mirongo itatu (30 drinkers). Iyo bibaye ngombwa ntugurishe inkoko zawe mugihe cy'ibyumweru 4, ushobora kongeramo ibindi bikoresho inkoko zinyweramo. Icyitonderwa: Mu buzima busanzwe inkoko inywa amazi angana na litiro ebyiri kugera kuri eshatu (2 - 3L) ku kiro kimwe cy'ibiryo (1kg), gusa ibi birahinduka mugihe cy'izuba ryinshi cyangwa mu duce dushyuha cyane.

Ibyangombwa n'ibikoresho bikenerwa mu kwita ku mushwi w'umunsi umwe kugera ku kweziIsaso; Isaso igomba kuba yujuje ibi bikurikira; yumutse, idafite umwanda, yoro - shye kandi ifite umubyimba uhagije (5 - 8 cm). Amazi n'ibiryo; Ibiryo bigomba kuba ari byiza, bifite intungamubiri zihagije kandi bihagije, zinabigeraho neza. Amazi agomba guhora mu kiraro buri gihe, byoroheye inkoko kuyageraho kandi akaba ari amazi meza. Urumuri; Urumuri ni ingezi ku mikurire y'imishwi kuko rutuma igira ubushake bwo kurya bitryo bigatuma habaho kwiyongera kw'ibiro ndetse no mugihe zitera bigatyma umusaruro w'amagi wiyongera. Ku munsi wa mbere urumuri rugomba guhoraho amasaha 24 kuri 24, hanyuma guhera ku munsi wa kabiri hakagenda hagabanukaho isaha imwe buri munsi. Ubushyuhe; Umworozi agomba gutangira gushyushya ikiraro byibura amasaha 48 mbere yuko imishwi imugeraho, ibi bifasha mu kwirukana ubukonje ndetse n'im - pumuro mbi ishobora guterwa n'umuti aba yarakoresheje asukura ikiraro. Umwuka; Inkonko kimwe n'ibindi binyabuzima zikenera umwuka, nimuri urwo rwego ikieraro kigomba kuba cyubatse kuburo umwuka mubi ubasha gusohoka n'umwuka mwiza ukinjira bitryo hakabaho ihindagurika ry'umwuka mu kiraro.

Umubare w'amafaranga yishingirwa kuri buri gihingwa ubarwa uhereye ku gaciro k'ibikoreshwa byose kugirango umusaruro ugerweho nukuvuga amafaranga yose y'igishoro. igishoro kiba kigizwe n'amafaranga yose asohoka nukuvuga Abakozi, imbuto, imiti, ifumbire, n'ibindi bitwara amafaranga bifite ibiciro bimenyerewe bidahinduka bijyanye no gukodesha ibikoresho by'ubuhinzi / imashini zikoreshwa mu kurima, guca imirongo, gutabira, gutera, n'indi mirimo isa niyo.

Gahunda ya Girinka igamije koroza Imiryango ikennye mu rwego rwo kwiteza imbere, kubona amata yo kunywa harwanywa imirire mibi asagutse akaba yagurishwa amafaranga avuyemo agafasha umuryango kwiteza imbere, gutanga ifumbire ikoreshwa mu buhinzi bityo umusaruro w'ubuhinzi ukiyongera, ndetse ifasha no mu kurwanya isuri haterwa ubwatsi bw'amatungo bufata ubutaka. Iyi gahunda kandi ifasha mu gushimagira imibanire / umubano mwiza mu banyarwanda nk'umuco wo guhana inka mu miryango binyuze mu kugabirana.

Ifumbire y'imborera ni ifumbire ituruka ku binyabuzima byose biboze bivuze ifumbire y'ibishanguka, n'ifumbire y'amatungo y'iminyorogoto, y'ibyatsi bitabikwa mu butaka cyange bivangwa n'imyaka bigakurura umunyu wa azote mu butaka uva mu kirere. Akamaro k'ifumbire y'imborera kagizwe n'ibi bikurikira: Ituma ubutaka bworoha bityo ntibugore guhinga; Yongera udukoko tw'ubunyabuzima mu butaka, bikongera ubuzima kubutaka; Irinda isuri ubutaka kuko ituma bubika amazi aho gutwarwa nayo kandi bugahora buhehereye; Ituma umuka utembera neza mu butaka; Igaburira ubutaka itanga imyunyu igihingwa kiba gikeneye; Ivugurura imiterere y'ubutaka kuko ituma utunonkononko dukoze ubutaka twegerana; Ni intungamubiri z'udukoko tumwe na tumwe twangombwa mu kugaburira ubutaka n'ibihingwa; Igabanya ubusharire bw'ubutaka; Igabanya uburozi bumwe na bumwe mu butaka kandi ikaba yifitemo ubushobozi bwo gufasha igihingwa guhangana n'indwara.

Ifumbire y'iminyorogoto yatangira gukoreshwa nyuma y'ukwezi umaze gushyira ibikenewe byose mu gisanduku cyabugenewe, ifumbire iba imaze kuboneka ukajya usarura rimwe mu kwezi. Ifumbire isarurwa hifashishijwe urumuri kuko rwirukana iminyorogoto. Iyo upfunduye / ukuyeho ishashi iminyorogoto yose yibira mw'ifumbire ukayora ifumbire yo hejuru. Ugenda uyigaburirira iruhande rumwe iminyorogoto ikajya yimukira ahari ibiryo ugakura ifumbire aho yavuye.

Urugero rw'ishwagara yo gushyira mu butaka ruterwa n'urugero rw'ubusharire bwabwo ndetse n'igihingwa. Ubutaka burimo ifumbire y'imborera ihagije busaba ishwagara nkeya. Ibiro hagati ya 20 na 30 by'ishwagara kuri ari 1 biba bihagije. Ishwagara ivangwa neza n'ubutaka iterwa ibyumweru 2 mbere yo gutera imyaka. Guterana n'imyaka bishobora gutuma ibabuka.
Imirimo y'ubuhinzi ikorwa n'imashini iyi: Kurima; Gusanza; Gutera imbuto, Gutera imiti, Kubagara, Gusarura, Guhungura; Kumisha, Gutoranya, Gukonjesha ibyangirika n'izindi.
Gushyira ifumbire y'imborera ku bigori bikorwa bitya: Gukoresha ifumbire mborera ingana na toni cumi kuri hegitari. Gucukura utwobo two gutera dufite nka cm 10 z'ubujyakuzimu.

Ifumbire zikunze gukoreshwa igihe cyo gutera ibigori ni DAP (18 - 46 - 0) ivanzena ire (46 - 0 - 0), NPK (17 - 17 - 17) na CEREALS (23 - 10 - 5 + 2Mg + 3S + 0. 3Zn). Iyo uhisemo gukoresha DAP ivanze na ire, uvanga biro 100 bya DAP na n'ibiro 50 bya ire, ugatera iyo mvange kuri hegitari imwe cyangwa ukavanga ikilo 1 ya DAP na n'ibiro zeru n'ibice bitanu bya ire ugatera iyo mvange kuri ari imwe. Bityo ukaba ukoresheje ibiro 41 by'umunyu ngugu wa azote (nitrogen) na n'ibilo 46 by'umunyu ngugu wa fosifore (phosphorus) kuri hegitari. Iyo uhisemo gukoresha NPK (17 - 17 - 17), utera kg 250 kuri hegitari imwe cyangwa kg 2, 5 kuri ari imwe. Bityo ukaba ukoresheje kg 42, 5 by'umunyu ngugu wa azote, kg 42, 5 by'umunyu ngugu wa fosifore na kg 42, 5 by'umunyu ngugu wa potasiyumu (potasium). Iyo uhisemo gukoresha CEREALS (23 - 10 - 5 + 2Mg + 3S + 0. 3Zn), utera kg 200 kuri hegitari. Bityo, ukaba ukoresheje kg 46 by'umunyu ngugu wa azote, kg 20 by'umunyu ngugu wa fosifore na kg 10 by'umunyu ngugu wa potasiyumu. Kandi hiyongeraho iyi myunyu ngugu ikoreshwa ku rugero ruto n'ibihingwa: kg 4 by'umunyu ngugu wa managanese, kg 6 by'umunyu ngugu wa sirifire na kg 0, 6 by'umunyu ngugu wa zenke. Iyo ukoresheje DAP (18 - 46 - 0) ivanze na ire (46 - 0 - 0) mu gihe cyo gutera, ushyira mu kobo ko gutera ivange ingana n'agafuniko kamwe n'igice. Iyo ukoresheje NPK (17 - 17 - 17), ushyir1 muri buri kobo ifumbire ingana n'udufuniko dutatu twa fanta. Naho wakoresha CEREALS igihe cyogutera, ushyiramu koboko guteraudufuniko tubiri twa Fanta. Ushyiraifumbire mvaruganda hejuru y'ifumbire, hanyumaukarenza ho agataka kugiringo ifumbire mvaruganda ntize gutwika impeke, ugasigaza ubujyakuzimu bungana na cm3 zo gutera mo imbuto. Warangiza ukarenza ho agatka ukaringaniza umurima.

Kongera ifumbire ku bigori mu gihe cyo kubagara bikorwa bitya: Iyo wakoresheje DAP (18 - 46 - 0) + ire (46 - 0 - 0) cyangwa NPK (17 - 17 - 17) mu gutera, wongeramo ire nyuma y'imyumweru bitandatu mu misozi migufi n'imisozi iciriritse cyangwa birndwi mu misozi miremire umaze gutera.

Mu kurwanya no kwirinda icyonnyi cya bariyentaraza cyangwa Kurisuka umuhinzi akora ibi bikurikira: Kurandura Bariyentaraza itarazana ururabo, cyangwe ururabo rutangiye kuza, ariko imbuto zitaraza mu rurabo kuko imbuto zayo zishobora kumara imyaka makumyabiri bigitegereje igihingwa; Gusimburanya ibinyampeke n'ibinyamisogwe cyangwe ibinyabijumba; Gukoresheje ifumbire mborera ndetse n'ifumbire mvaruganda; Kwirinda kunyuza amatungo mu murima wagaragayemo Bariyentaraza kuko ashobora kuyijyana mu yindi mirima.

Nkongwa y'ibigori irwanywa mu buryo bukurikira: Gusimburanya ibigori n'ibinyamisogwe cyangwa n'ibinyabijumba bigabanya ikwirakwira rya nkongwa; Gufumbira ubutaka hakoreshejwe ifumbire y'imborera; Kugenzura umurima bihoraho bifasha kurwanya ikibazo hakiri kare. Kuvanga ibigori n'urubingo cyangwadesimodiyumu murwegomrwo gukumira nkogwa; Isuku y'umurima: Gutaba ikigorigori nyuma yo gusarura cyangwa bikagaburirwa amatungo; Mu gihe ibigori byafashwe birenze 10 %, ushobora kurwanya nkongwa ukoresheje imiti nka lambdacyhalothrin, cypermethrin + profenofos (roket) ku rugero rwa15ml / litiro 15 z'amazi.

Nkongwa idasanzwe mu bigori irwanywa mu buryo bukurikira: Guhinga ugeza isuka hasi ugamije kugaragaza, kuvanamo cyangwa gutaba nkongwa n'ibikonoshwa byayo; Kongerera ibihingwa ubudahangarwa hakoreshwa ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza n'imvaruganda ku bipimo nyabyo hamwe no kuhira; Gusimburanya mu murima ibinyampeke n'ibinyamisogwe nk'ibishyimbo na soya cyangwa n'ibinyabijumba nk'ibirayi n'ibijumba; Gutoragura ibishorobwa bya nkongwa idasanzwe mumurima no kubyica; Gukoresha umuti wica udukoko utera cyane cyane mu mwumba nka: Cypermethrin 4 % + profenofos 40 % (roket, target, cypro, jaket) ku rugero rwa mililitiro 1 kugera kuri 2 z'umuti muri litiro 1 y'amazi, Lambda - Cyhalothrin garama 50 / litiro, ku rugero rwa mililitiro 1 kugera kuri 2 z'umuti muri litiro 1 y'amazi; Pyrethrum 5 % EWC, ku rugero rwa mililitiro 8 muri litiro 1 y'amazi. Acetamiprid garama 20 muri litiro + Lambda - Cyhalothrin garama 16 muri litiro na mililitiro 4 kugera kuri 6 muri litiro y'amazi.

Kwirinda no kurwanya indwara y'uruhumbu mu ngano bikorwa ku buryo bukurikira: Guhinga imbuto zihanganira indwara. Gukoresha ifumbire mvaruganda uko bikwiye, kandi ku gihe. Kurandura kimeza buri gihe. Kubuza abantu benshi kugendagenda mu murima w'ingano; Kubagara igihe cyose ari ngombwa; Gusimburanya ingano n'indi myaka. Gutera umuti wa tebuconazole uvangwa ku gipimo cya mililitiro imwe kuri litiro imwe y'amazi.

kwirinda no kurwanya imungu mu ngano bikorwa ku buryo bukurikira: Kugirira isuku ubuhunikiro, Koresha imifuka ya PICS (Purdue Improved Crops Storage bags) irinda imungu. Guhungira intete n'umuti urimo Malathion + Permethrin (nka Super Skana). Vanga garama 2. 5 z'umuti (Malathion + Permethrin) mu kilo kimwe cy'imbuto.

Umuceri ufumbirwa mu buryo bukurikira: Kuri Hegitari 1 bashyiramo ibiro 200 bya NPK 17. 17. 17 mu gihe cyo gutera n'ibiro 100 za Ire (urea) aho ibiro 50 bya Ire babishyiramo nyuma y'ibyumweru 3 bamaze gutera ifumbire ya NPK naho ibindi biro 50 bya Ire bakabyongeramo umuceri utangiye guhagika. Icyitonderwa: Mbere yo gushyiramo ifumbire, ni ngombwa kubanza kuvana amazi mu mirima.

Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanda Uburima mu muceri bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Gutera imbuto nzima cyangwa zihanganira indwara, Gutera imbuto umuti mbere yo guhumbika (enrobage), Kubahiriza ibihe by'ihinga, Isuku mu murima nahawegereye, gutwika ibikenyeri by'umuceri nyuma yo gusarura, Kuyobora amazi ahagije mu murima, Gutera ifumbire nyayo ku rugero nyarwo, Gukoresha umuti nka Tricyclazole, Tebuconazole, Benomyl.

Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya indwara yo kubabuka k'umuceri ni ub bukurikira: Gutera imbuto umuti mbere yo guhumbika (enrobage), Gutera imbuto nzima (zitarwaye), Kugira isuku mu murima n'ahawegereye, Gufumbira neza (gukoreshaifumbire y'imborera n'imvaruganda kurugeronyarwo), Kuyobora neza amazi mu murima, Imiti ikoreshwa mu kurwanya uburima bw'umuceri ni nayo ikoreshwa mu kurwanya indwara yo kubabuka k'umuceri.

Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya indwara y'isazi y'umuceri ni ubu bukurikira: Gusukura umurima no kubagara uko bikwiye, Kuzamura urugero rw'amazi mu mirima mu gihe hari ibimenyetso; Gutwika ibikenyeri nyuma yo gusarura, Gukoresha imiti yo kurwanya isazi nka Deltamethrine, Cypermethrine, Imidachloprid ku rugero rwa mililitiro 1 y'umuti kuri litiro1 y'amazi.

Dore ingano y'ifumbire ijya kuri hegitari y'ibishyimbo: Bashyiramo toni icumi (10T) z'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza kuri hegitari imwe (1Ha) mu gihe cy'itabira; Bakongeramo ifumbire mvaruganda kilo ijana (100 Kg) za DAP mw'itera kuri hegitari (Ha); Mu butaka busharira bashyiramo toni ebyiri n'igice (2. 5T) kugeza kuri toni enye (4T) z'ishwagara byibura ibyumweru bibiri mbere yo gutera. Iyo shwagara iba igomba kumaramo ibihembwe by'ihinga bine (4).

Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya indwara y'ikiziga mu bishyimbo ni ubu bukurikira: Gutera amoko yihanganira iyo ndwara, guhungira imbuto hakoreshejwe imiti nka Benomyl bakoresheje garama ebyiri (2) za buri bwoko mu kilo kimwe cy'ibishyimbo.

Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya Ubuhunduguru mu bishyimbo ni ubu bukurikira: Uburyo budahenze busaba gukoresha urusenda, ivu, isabune, amaganga bivanze n'amazi. Bubaye budapfuye tera umuti wa Profenofos 40g + Cypermethrin 4g: 1ml / 1Litiro y'amazi. Iyo hagaragaye utu dusimba ku gice gito cy'umurima w'ibishyimbo ni ngombwa gutera ku bihingwa byose.

Bimwe mu bipimo nyabyo by'ibikoresho bikenerwa mu gukora imigina herekanwe uburyo bubiri. Ibyo byose bivangwa n'amazi angana na litiro 60 bikavamo imvange ishobora gukora imigina 100. uburyo bwa mbere: 1. Ifu y'urubingo ibiro 36; 2. Ibisigazwa by'umuceri ibiro 10; 3. Ishwagara ikilo kimwe; Uburyo bwa kabiri: 1. Ipamba ibiro 36; 2. Ibisigazwa by'umuceri ibiro 10; 3.

Dore uko bahinga ibihumyo; Mbere na mbere ni ngombwa kugenzura umugina ugiye gutera, umugina mwiza uba ari umweru, wererana udafite inenge. Mu gihe ugiye gutera umugina urawufata ugakuraho ishashi neza witonze. Uburyo bwo gutera imigina ni ubu bukurikira: Nyuma yo gucukura akaringoti, unyanyagizamo ishwagara, ugatereka imigina mu butaka utondekanya ku murongo wegeranya umwe ku wundi, warangiza ukorosaho agataka ka cm 1 noneho ukavomerera n'amazi. Muri rusange umugina umwe uvomererwa na mililitiro magana atatu (ml 300) ariko igipimo cya nyacyo giterwa n'ubuhehere bw'ubutaka buhinzemo ikindi wirinda kuhira mugihe ibihumyo byatangiye kuzamuka. Bitewe n'uburyo wahinzemo, hari aho udatwikiriza ishashi ni aho uyitwikiriza igondeye ku biti kugira ngo hagumemo ubuhehere kandi hatagira ikibazo cyo kumagara kugeza igihe bitangiye kuzamuka.

Kumisha ibihumyo ni byiza bituma bibikika igihe kirekire, ikilo kimwe (1Kg) cy'ibihumyo byumye kiboneka mu biro biri hagati y'ibiro 10 na 12 by'ibihumyo bibisi; ku isoko ry'u Rwanda kikagura amafaranga y'u Rwanda ari hagati y'ibihumbi 10, 000 - 15, 000 ku kilo. Ubu buryo bwagoboka abahinzi b'ibihumyo kuko nabwo burimo inyungu, bityo ntihakabeho umusaruro upfa ubusa, dore ko isosi ikoze mu bihumyo byumye cyangwa se ifu yabyo iba iryoshye cyane.

Iyi ni indwara ituma ibinyamacunga bishyirwa mu kato ku isoko mpuzamahanga. Ishobora kugabanya umusaruro ku kigereranyo cya 50 - 100 %. Iyi ndwara ikwirakwira igihe ikirere gifite ubuhehere kigakurikirwa n'ikirere cyumye n'ubushyuye buri ku kigero cya 22 - 26°C. Amababi n'imbuto bikiri bito nibyo iyi ndwara yibasira cyane. Amababi niyo akunze kubika ubu burwayi kandi bukwirakwizwa n'umuyaga n'imvura.  Ibimenyetso n'uko yangiza; Iyi ndwara irangwa n'ibidomo by'ibizeru ku mababi bishobora kwaguka bigahura. Ibyo bidomo birangwa n'ibara ry'ibihogo (brown) cyangwa ikigina (grayish) hagati rizengurutswe n'ibara ry'umuhondo. Amababi akivuka ashobora kugwa imburagihe. Ku mbuto, ibidomo bigira amabara asa nk'ayavuzwe ku mababi. Imbuto zikiri nto zizaho uturomba dukikijwe n'ibara ry'umuhondo kandi zigakomera kuburyo nta numutobe zigira. Ku mbuto zifashwe zikuze, ibidomo bimera nk'ibyinjiyemo imbere kandi umutobe uragabanuka.  Uko wayirinda; Kuzengurutsa umurima w'amacunga uruzitiro ruhagarika umuyaga kuko ukwirakwiza cyane ubu burwayi. Kwirinda gutera ibiti bishya ubivanga n'ibishaje. Kwirinda icyazana ubukonje n'ubuhehere bwinshi mubiti bw'amacunga. Gukonorera ibiti by'amacunga kugirango urumuri n'umwuka bibashe gukwirakwira mu mashami y'igiti hose arinako ukuraho udushami twagaragaje uburwayiGutoragura no gutaba mu cyobo cyabugenewe imbuto n'amababi byaguye kubera ubu burwayi.  Uko wayirwanya; Gutera imiti yica uduhumyo: Gusimburanya imiti irimo sulfur (nka Thiovit, Thiogil) n'irimo copper (nka Oxychlorre de cuivre, Oxide de cuivre, Hydroxide de cuivre), chlorothalonil (Daconil) na carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim). Gutera umuti bikorwa buri byumweru bibiri igihe uburwayi bwagaragaye.

Kwita ku buhumbikiro bw'Amashu, borocoli na shufurere bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: ● Nyuma yo kwinaza shyiraho isaso y'ibyatsi byumye neza. ● Kuraho isaso ingemwe zikimara kumera (nyuma y'iminsi 4 kugeza ku 10). ● Ubakira ubuhumbikiro unabutwikire bityo birinde ingemwe kwicwa n'izuba. Wibuke gusiga aho imirasire y'izuba inyura kuko ingemwe ziba zirikeneye. ● Vomerera buri munsi mu gitondo kare no kumugoroba. ● Icira ingemwe igihe zicucitse. ● Tera imiti irwanya indwara (mancozeb cyangwa methalaxyl: garama 2. 5 / litiro y'amazi) n'ibyonnyi (Lambda - Cyhalothrin: 1 ml / 1l y'amazi) bibaye ngombwa. ● Gabanya igihe cyo kuvomerera kandi ugende ugabanya igicucu cy'ubuhumbikiro mu gihe cy'icyumweru 1 cyangwa 2 mbere yo kugemura kugirango ingemwe zikomere. ● Tera ingemwe mu murima hashize iminsi 25 - 30 nyuma yo kwinaza (zifite amababi 3 - 4).

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi mu mashu, borocoli na shufurere bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Genzura umurima buri munsi witegereza neza uruhande rwo hasi rw'amababi kuko ari ho udusimba dufata mu gihe twihisha izuba n'imvura. Indwara zikunze kuzahaza amashu, borocoli na shufure ni: kuma ku mpande z'amababi (black rot), ububore buterwa na bagiteri n'izindi ziterwa na bagiteri. Irinde indwara utera usimburanya imiti ikurikira irimo cuwivure (copper) urugero gitenge, komanda na funguran. Ibyonnyi bikunze kugarara ni inda z'ibihingwa, nyamwihina (cabbage looper). Rwanya udukoko ukoresheje imiti nka cypermethrin, Lambdacyhalothrin (Lamdex), abamectin (Dudu abamectin) na acetameprid (Aster extrem).
Aho amatunda ahingwa: Amatunda ahingwa mu gihugu hose. Amatunda ni igihingwa gikunda ubutaka buseseka, bufite ifumbire kandi butarimo amazi menshi.

Gufumbira Amatunda bikorwa gutya: Bashyira kg 30 z'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza mu mwobo uzaterwamo intababara; Bakongeramo g 500 za NPK 17. 17. 17, kandi bigakorwa buri mwaka iyo yatangiye kwera imbuto.

Gufata neza cyangwa kwita ku matunda mu mirima bikorwa: Kuyubakira ingazi, hakoreshwa ingiga z'ibiti bifite m 2, 70 z'uburebure, cm; 15 z'umurambararo; cm bagataba 60. Ni ngombwa gufasha urugemwe kurira rukagera kuri twa tugozi, ushyira hagati y'urugemwe n'utugozi umuhembezo; Kubagara no gusasira; Gukata Marakuja; Ikata ritereka igiti: hatoranywa ibishibu 2 bitarangwaho indwara, ibindi; bigakatwa; Ikata rituma igiti cyera neza: bakata imitwe hejuru y'utujisho tuzabyara andi mashami, bituma igiti gikura vuba; Gukata udushami tutagifite imbuto cyangwa twangiritse; Ikata risazura igiti: gukatira igiti kuri cm 30 uvuye ku butaka iyo umusaruro; utangiye kugabanuka; Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi hakoreshejwe amoko yihanganira indwara no gutera imiti.

Indwara ya Kabore ku matunda; Iyi ndwara ikunze kugaragazwa no guhinduka umuhondo ku mababi, kubora k'uruti rwo hasi agereye ubutaka bitaguma igihingwa cyose kiraba ndetse nyuma kikabora iyo usatuye uruti usanga imbere hasa n'ikigina. Iyi ndwara iterwa n'agakoko kangiza ingemwe zikiri ntoya kuruti aho gatuma uduhumyo tubona umwanya wo gutangira kwangiza uruti kuko butaba bubonye aho kwinjirira. Uko Indwara ya Kabore ku matunda bayirwanya: - Igiti cyamaze gufatwa kirarandurwa kigatwikwa / gutabwa, - Gukoresha neza neza sekateri mugukuraho ibyafashwe hirindwa kwanduzaibindi, - Kwirinda ibyatsi cyangwa isaso yeregereye ku ruti, - Gukoresha ingemwe zibanguriye kuko zihanganira iki kibazo, - Gukoresha imiti yica ubusimba mu gihe cyo gutegura ingemwe n'imiti irimocuivre mu mbuto ziteye mu murima.

Gusarura no guhunika amatunda cyangwa marakuja; Amatunda cyangwa Marakuja zitangira gusarurwa nyuma y'amezi 7 zitewe, igiti kimwe kigatanga 12 kg z'imbuto buri mwaka. Marakuja zifashwe neza zitanga 20 toni z'umusaruro kuri Ha. Imbuto zeze neza zibikwa mu gihe kitari kirekire kuri 20°C n'ubuheherebwa 80 - 90 %. Umutobe n'umushongi bikabikika neza kurusha.

Uko batera Makadamiya n'imirimo ikorerwa ingemwe ziterwa; • Umurima utunganywa neza mu gihe cy'izuba (icyi): barima inshuro 2 mbere yo gutera. Bacukura imyobo ya cm 60 z'umurambararo na cm 60 z'ubujyakuzimu, bagashyiramo udutebo 2 tw'ifumbire y'imborera ivanze n'igitaka cyo hejuru na g 60 za NPK 20. 10. 10. • Batera makadamiya mu gihe cy'imvura kuri m 7. 5 hagati y'imirongona m 7. 5 hagati y'igiti n'ikindi (ibiti 178 muri Ha) mu murima wihariye cyangwa m 10 na m 10 hagati y'imirongo n'igiti n'ikindi mu murima. • Bashingirira ingemwe kugira ngo zitazunguzwa n'umuyaga mwinshi kandi basasira muri cm 10 - 15 uvuye ku giti. Makadamiya ntikunda gukatwa cyane, bakuraho amashami yavunitse cyangwa ayumye agakatwa yegerejwe igihimba kugira ngo igiti gihagarare neza.

Intungamubiri, agaciro n'inyungu makadamiya izanira abahinzi bayo; - Imbuto za makadamiya zitanga ibivumbikisho bihanitse (Kcal 7350 kuri kg 1), zifite amavuta menshi aruta ibindi bihingwa (73 - 78 %) by'ibinyamavuta (ubunyobwa 44. 8 %, soya 15. 7 %) kandi ntifite ibinure bitera indwara. Zikungahaye kuri vitamini (A, B na C) n'imyunyungungu nka kalisiyumu, fosifori na Feri). - Makadamiya irakenewe cyane ku isoko mpuzamahanga aho igura amadolari10 - 20 kuri kg 1. Umusaruro uboneka ku isi ni 45 % k'ukeneye.

Icyonnyi cy'Agasimba gatobora imbuto za Macadamia (Macadamia Nut borer): Imiterere y'icyonnyi cy'Agasimba gatobora imbuto za Macadamianuko n'uko twangiza: - Ni agakoko ko mubwoko bw'ibinyugunyugu gisa n'umutuku w'ikigina gitera amagi ku mbuto; Urunyo rugakurira imbere mu rubuto cyangwa mu gishishwa kikazasohokamo kimaze gukura. - Urubuto rwangiritse rugaragazwa n'utwenge duto turihi imyanda kandi urunyo rwangiza cyane imbuto zikiri nyota cyane. Uko Agasimba gatobora imbuto za Macadamia bakarwanya: - Gukata ibiti no kwirinda ibihuru mu murima, - Gukoresha imiti nka Imidachloprid, bifenthrin cyane cyane mu gihe cy'irabya.

Kwita ku buhumbikiro bwa beterave; • Nyuma yo kwinaza shyiraho isaso y'ibyatsi byumye neza. • Kuraho isaso ingemwe zikimara kumera. • Ubakira ubuhumbikiro unabutwikire bityo birinde ingemwe kwicwa n'izuba. Wibuke gusiga aho imirasire y'izuba inyura kuko ingemwe ziba zirikeneye. • Vomerera buri munsi mu gitondo kare no kumugoroba. Icira ingemwe igihe zicucitse. • Tera imiti irwanya indwara (mancozeb cyangwa methalaxyl: garama 2. 5 / litiro y'amazi) n'ibyonnyi (Lambda - Cyhalothrin: 1 ml / 1l y'amazi) bibaye ngombwa. • Gabanya igihe cyo kuvomerera kandi ugende ugabanya igicucu cy'ubuhumbikiro mu gihe cy'icyumweru 1 cyangwa 2 mbere yo kugemura kugirango ingemwe zikomere. • Tera ingemwe mu murima hashize iminsi 25 nyuma yo kwinaza.

Gufumbira ibireti bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira; Kuri hegitari imwe (1Ha), bashyiramo toni 10 (10T) z'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza mbere yo gutera n'ibiro maganabiri (200 Kg) by'ifumbire mvaruganda (TSP) mu gihe cyo gutera.

Gufata neza ibireti mu mirima; Imirimo y'ingenzi igomba gukorwa: • gusimbura ingemwe zitafashe; • kubagara igihe cyose hagaragaye ibyatsi bibi; • gukata amashari (amashami yumye); • kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi hakoreshejwe amoko yihanganira indwara no gutera imiti.

Gutegura umurima no gutera intoryi; Shyira ubuhumbikiro ahadaheruka guhingwamo intoryi cyangwa ibihingwa byo mu muryango umwe mu bihe by'ihinga nibura 2. Hinga umurima neza ku bujyakuzimu bwa cm 20 - 30 kandi ibyatsi bibi n'ibindi bisigazwa byose ubikuremo, ndetse n'ibinonko ubimenagure. Tegura ubuhumbikiro bufite ubugali bwa metero 1 kugeza kuri 1. 2 n'ubujyejuru bwa cm 20; Icyumweru kimwe mbere yo guhumbika, vangira kuri metero kare imwe ibiro 3 - 5 (amashyi atatu) by'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza, NPK 17 - 17 - 17 garama 20 (udufuniko 2 tw'agacupa k'amazi y'Inyange) n'itaka. Ku munsi wo kwinaza, ca imirongo yo kwinazamo ifite ubujyakuzimu bwa cm 0. 5 kandi itandukanijwe na cm 10 - 15. Shyira imbuto muri ya mirongo waciye ku ntera ya cm 2 hagatiy ' urubuto n'urundi, urenzeho agataka gacye. Icyitonderwa: Ingemwe z'intoryi zishobora gutegurirwa mu bihoho bipakirwamo itaka n'imborera iboze neza ku ngero za 2: 1 (urugero: ingorofani ebyiri z'itaka n'imwe y'imborera). Hashobora kandi gukoreshwa ibikoresho byabugenewe byitwa tereyi (Trays). Umuhinzi ufite umurima wa ari imwe aba akeneye umurama ungana na g 1 ku bwoko bwa iburide, na g 5 ku bwoko butari iburide.

Gushyiraho ifumbire mvaruganda ku ntoryi bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira; ● Ku ntoryi za iburide, shyiraho garama 10 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 (agafuniko kamwe k'icupa ry'amazi y'Inyange) kuri buri rugemwe nyuma y'icyumweru uteye (Hakoreshwa kg 1. 75 kuri ari imwe). Ongeraho garama 10 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 - 17 (agafuniko kamwe k'icupa ry'amazi y'Inyange) kuri buri rugemwe nyuma y'ukwezi uteye na nyuma y'amezi abiri uteye. ● Kuri ari imwe, haba hakenewe kg 3. 5 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17. Nyuma y'amezi atatu uteye, ongeraho garama 5 za ire (agafuniko k'icupa rya fanta) kuri buri rugemwe (Kuri ari imwe, hakoreshwa kg 0. 9 za Ire). ● Ku ntoryi zitari iburide, shyiraho garama 10 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 (agafuniko k'icupa ry'amazi y'Inyange), nyuma y'icyumweru uteye. Kuri ari imwe, haba hakenewe kg 3. 5 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17. Nyuma y'ukwezi n'igice uteye, ongeraho garama 3 za ire (agafuniko k'icupa rya fanta kageze ku musozo) kuri buri rugemwe. Kuri ari imwe, haba hakenewe kg 0. 9 za Ire.

Kugenzura indwara n'ibyonnyi mu ntoryi ni ukugenzura umurima inshuro eshatu mu cyumweru (cg buri munsi) urebamo ibyonnyi n'ibimenyetso bigaragaza indwara z'uduhumyo, virusi na bagiteri. Wibande kureba munsi y'amababi kuko niho ubusimba bufata mu gihe twihisha izuba n'imvura. Iyo ubonyeho ibyonnyi cyangwa ibimenyetso by'indwara utera umuti.

Gutegura umurima no gutera karoti; • Hitamo umurima udaheruka guhingwamo ibimera biri mu muryango umwe na karoti aribyo sereri, perisire n'ibindi mu gihembwe cy'ihinga giheruka. • Hinga neza ugeza isuka mu butaka ku bujyakuzimu bwa cm 30 kugirango bifashe kuringaniza ubutaka neza, guhitisha umwuka no gushora kwa karoti. • Menagura ibinonko byose ukuramo amabuye n'ibyatsi byose. • Kora imitabo izamuye ya m 1 - 1. 2 z'ubugali n'ubujyejuru bwa cm 20; • Nyanyagiza imborera iboze neza, kg 250 kuri ari ku mitabo uyivange neza n'itaka mu cyumweru kimwe mbere yo gutera. Ca uduferege dufite ubujyakuzimu butarengeje cm 3 kandi dutandukanijwe n'intera ya cm 20. • Shyiramo ifumbire mvaruganda ya DAP ingana na garama 25 (udufuniko tubiri n'igice tw'agacupa k'amazi y'Inyange) na KCl ingana na garama 40 (udufuniko tune tw'agacupa k'amazi y'Inyange) k'umurongo wa m 10. • Renza agataka ku ifumbire usiba uduferege ku buryo hasigara ubujyakuzimu budasibye bwa cm 0. 5 - 1. • Kubera ko umurama wa karoti ari muto cyane, murwego rwo kwirinda ubucucike, tera umurama wa karoti umaze kuwuvanga n'itaka ryumye neza cyangwa umucanga ku buryo udashobora kubona imbuto 3 - 5 ziri hamwe. • Humbika umurama uvanze n'itaka cyangwa umucanga muri twa duferege wakoze hanyuma utwikirizeho agataka gake. • Twikiraza imitabo ibyatsi byumye neza ariko uhite ubikuraho karoti zikimera.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi muri karoti; • Genzura umurima buri munsi witegereza neza uruhande rwo hasi rw'amababi kuko ari ho udusimba dufata mu gihe twihisha izuba n'imvura. • Karoti zikunda guhura n'uburwayi butandukanye aribwo, Indwara yo kubabuka amababi (leaf blight, ifoto 1a), uruhumbu rw'umweru (powdery mildew, ifoto 1b), n'ibibara bicukutse (cavity spot, ifoto 1c) ziterwa n'uduhumyo. • Kurwanya indwara ziterwa n'uduhumyo ukoresheje imiti nka Mancozeb + Metalaxyl (Victory), chlorothalonil 50 % wp (Daconil, odeon 720SC), cg copper oxychloride 50 % wp (Gitenge), Carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim), sulfur (Thiovit). • Indwara ziterwa na bagiteri arizo: kubabuka kw'amababi (bacterial wilt, ifoto 2a) amaga (scrab, ifoto 2b) n'ububore bw'umukara (black rot, ifoto 2c), n'iziterwa na virusi (carrot motley dwarf, ifoto 2d) n'izindi. Ibyonnyi bikunze kugaragara ni amasazi (carrot rust fly). • Irinde indwara ziterwa na bagiteri, utera usimburanya imiti ikurikira irimo kuwivure (copper) urugero gitenge, komanda na funguran, kuko izo ndwara zitavurwa. • Rwanya indwara ziterwa na virusi ukoresha imiti irwanya udukoko (Rocket, dudu abamectin, Lamdex) kuko nta miti yihariye yica virus.

Uburyo bwo Guhita utera umurama / umwayi w'imbwija cyangwa dodo mu murima; ● Ubu ni uburyo bwihuse kandi bworoshye bwo guhinga imbwija / dodo. ● Shyira ifumbire y'imborera, y'inka cyangwa se y'inkoko mu murima ku gipimo cya kg 2 kuri metero 2. ● Vanga umucanga n'imbuto, umurayi kugira ngo byorohe kunyanyagiza mu mirongo (imirongo itandukanijwe na cm 40) ubundi urenzeho agataka gake unavomerere mu gihe imvura itagwa. ● Nyuma yibyumweru 2, icirira usiga cm 30 hagati y'uruboga n'urundi.

Uburyo bwo gutegura ubuhumbikiro no kugemurira ingemwe za dodo cyangwa imbwija mu murima. ● Bituma haboneka ingemwe nziza, nyinshi kandi zingana, ariko ibi bitinza gusarura bwa mbere. ● Shyira ubuhumbikiro ahagera urumuri ruhagije kuko birinda indwara n'ingemwe ntizishurumbuke. ● Vanga ubutaka n'ifumbire kg 2 - 3 kuri m2. ● Vanga imbuto n'umucanga, hanyuma utere usiga cm 10 hagati y'umurongo n'undi. Zimaze kumera icira usiga cm 2 hagati y'uruboga n'urundi. Imurira ingemwe mu murima nyuma y'ibyumeru 3 (urugemwe rufite nibura amababi 3 meza) kandi utere usiga cm 40 hagati y'imirongo na cm 30 hagati y'uruboga n'urundi mu murongo.

Ahantu haberanye n'ubuhinzi bwa kurujete ni aha khakurikira: Kurujete zikunda ubutaka bufite ifumbire nyinshi (ihagije), byaba n'akarusho burimo urubuye. Zikunda ahantu hari ubushyuhe buri hagati ya dogere 15 - 25, n'ubutumburuke buri hagati ya 500m na 2000m. Ubutaka bufite ubusharire buri hagati ya 5. 5 kugera kuri 7. 5 nibwo buberanye n'ubuhinzi bwa kurujete.

Gutegura umurima no guteramo kurujete bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Hitamo umurima udaherukamo ibihingwa biri mumuryango w'ibinyanzuzi (urugero: kokombure, ibicuma, wotemeroni, amadegede, kurujete) nibura nyuma y'ibihe by'ihinga 2. Tegura umurima icyumweru kimwe mbere yo kugemura. Hinga umurima ugeza isuka ku bujyakuzimu bwa cm 30. Mu gutera cukura imyobo ifite ubugari bwa cm 30 na cm 30 z'ubujyakuzimu. Hagati y'umwobo nundi hajyamo cm 50 — 100, hagati y'umurongo nundi hajyamo cm 100. Shyira mu mwobo kg 2 z'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza (amashyi abiri yuzuye neza mu mwobo) kandi uvange neza ifumbire n'itaka. Hakenerwa kg 200 Kuri ari imwe. Ongeraho NPK 17 - 17 - 17 ingana na garama 20 (udufuniko 2 tw'icupa ry'amazi y'inyange kuri buri mwobo); igihe cyo gutera hakenerwa kg 2 za NPK17 - 17 - 17 kuri ari. Kura ingemwe mu bihoho neza udakuyeho itaka rifashe ku mizi maze uzitere mu myobo yateguwe.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi muri Kurujete bikorwa gutya; Genzura umurima buri munsi witegereza neza uruhande rwo hasi rw'amababi kuko ari ho ubusimba n'indwara bifata mu gihe byihisha izuba n'imvura. Kurujete zikunda guhura n'uburwayi butandukanye aribwo: indwara y'akaribata (anthracnose), uruhumbu rw'umweru (powdery mildew) ziterwa uduhumyo, kirabiranya iterwa na bagiteri, iziterwa na virusi n'izindi. Ibyonnyi bikunze kugarara ni ibivumvuri by'ibihaza (cucurbit leaf beetles) n'inda z'ibihingwa. Rwanya indwara ziterwa n'uduhumyo ukoresheje imiti uyisimburanya nka Mancozeb + Metalaxyl (Victory), chlorothalonil (Daconil, odeon 720SC), copper oxychloride (Gitenge), Carbendazim (Rodazim, Bendazim), Sulfur (Thiovit). Irinde indwara ziterwa na bagiteri, utera usimburanya imiti ikurikira irimo cuwivure (copper) urugero gitenge, komanda na funguran, kuko izo ndwara zitavurwa. Rwanya indwara ziterwa na virusi ukoresha imiti irwanya udukoko (Rocket, dudu abamectin, Lamdex) kuko nta miti yihariye yica virus.

Kugenzura igihingwa ibiti bya pome: - Ni ngombwa kugenzura kenshi ibiti bya pome kugira ngo niba hariikibazo bifite kimenyekane kandi gikemurwe hakiri kare. - Biba byiza iyo umuntu ahora ahindura inzira anyuramo akora igenzura mu murima. - Mu kugenzura wita kukureba ibi bikurikira: umuswa mu butaka hafi y'igiti, indwara n'ibyonnyi ku mababi, guhindura ibara kw'amababi, n'ibindi. Ni byiza kwitegereza neza uruhande rwo hasi rw'amababi kuko ari ho ubusimba n'indwara bikunda gufata mu gihe byihisha izuba n'imvura. - Igihe cy'igenzura, harebwa kandi niba ibiti bigihagaze neza bikababyahengamurwa ndetse byaba bifite ibisambo bigakurwaho. - Mu gihe cyo gutera umuti ni ngombwa gukora ku buryo umuti ukwira ku ruhande rwo munsi rw'ikibabi kugira ngo ube wizeye ko wawuteye neza. - Genzura ubwone by'inyoni mu murima watangiye kuzana imbuto kuko inyoni zitangira kona imbuto za pome zikizaho kugeza zikuze.

Indwara y'uruhumbu rw'umweru muri pome (Powdery mildew) Ibimenyetso by'Indwara y'uruhumbu rw'umweru muri pome. Irangwa n'ifu isa n'ivu. Uruhumbu rugaragara cyane ku dushami dushyashya cyane ku ruhande rwo hejuru rw'amababi; Warwanya ute Indwara y'uruhumbu rw'umweru muri pome? - Gutera imiti irimo sufure (Thiovit / Thiogil), uyisimburanya na Chlorothalonil, Copper hydroxide / oxychloride, Gutera umuti bitangira igihe harimo gushibuka amababi mashya mbere yo kurabya, bigakomeza mu gihe cy'ururabo. Ibipimo by'umuti bikoreshwa mu kurwanya Indwara y'uruhumbu rw'umweru muri pome? - Sulphur 80 % WG: 40 - 160gr / 20L, Iminsi yo gusarura nyuma yo gutera umuti (PHI): Iminsi 3 - Chlorothalonil 50 % SC: 20ml / 20L, PHI Iminsi 7 - 15 - Copper hydroxide 50 % WP: 40 - 60ml / 20L, PHI: Iminsi 14 - Copper oxychloride 50 % WP: 50 - 70ml / 20L, PHI:

Ibyiza by'akarima gafite ishusho y'amaterasi y'indinganire ni ibi: 1. ako karima k'igikoni gafite umwihariko wo kurwanya isuri, kuko gakoranye ishusho nk'iyamaterasi y'indinganire 2. Iyo shusho ituma ako karima gashobora gufata amazi mu buryo bwose, bityo kakaba gashobora kumara igihe kinini ugereranyije n'akarima k'igikoni gasanzwe gakoreshwa. 3. Ako karima gakoze ku buryo umusaruro w'ibigahinzweho ushobora guhoraho igihe cyose, 4. ako karima k'igikoni kamara umwaka gatanga umusaruro, nyuma y'umwaka kakaba kagomba kuvugururwa hakoreshejwe ukuvanga ifumbire y'imborera n'itaka ryiza ku kigero kimwe.

Ubutaka buberanye na Siteviya: o Siteviya yera neza hafi ku butaka ubwo aribwo bwose ariko aho ikunda cyane ni mu butaka buseseka burimo agacanga gake kandi bukungahaye ku ifumbire mborera. o Siteviya yitwara neza igatanga umusaruro ushimishije ni ku butaka bufite igipimo cy'ubusharire (PH) buri hagati ya 6 na 7. 5. o Sitevia ikunda ubutaka buhehereye ariko kandi butarimo amazi menshi arengeje. Amazi areka mu butaka adatambuka neza yangiza imizi ya Siteviya. Uretse gusa mu butaka burimo umucanga, ubundi Siteviya itanga umusaruro mwiza iyo ihinzwe mu dutabo tuzamuyeho gato kugirango amazi abashe kujya akamukamo igihe yabayemo menshi. Sitevia ntikura neza ku butaka bw'urwunyunyu.

Gufumbira siteviya: Koresha Toni 20 z'ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza kuri Hegitari uri guhinga bwa nyuma utaratera ingemwe ndetse na buri nyuma yo gusarura; Koresha kandi ibiro 460 n'ifumbire mvaruganda ya NPK 17 - 17 - 17 mu byiciro bibiri, ni ukuvuga ibiro 230 kuri Hegitari mu gihe utera, n'ibiro 230 nyuma y'iminsi 45 uteye ingemwe.

Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi muri siteviya: Muri rusange Siteviya ntikunda guhura n'uburwayi bukabije cyangwa ibyonnyi byihariye uretse uduhumyo dukunda kubonekamo cyane cyane mu gihe cy'imvura. Kurwanya uburawyi buterwa n'uduhumyo, utera umuti wa Mancozeb cyangwa undi muti wose urwanya uduhumyo uboneka ku isoko. Ku bijyanye n'ibyonnyi, umuswa niwo ukunze kwangiza Siteviya cyane cyane mu duce dushyuha cyane. Kurwanya uwo muswa utera umuti urwanya umuswa uwo ariwo wose uboneka ku isoko.

Gufata neza umurima wa boberi: Iboberi itangira kwerekana ibibabi nyuma y'iminsi 15. Ikata rya mbere ritangira nyuma y'amezi 2 kugira ngo iboberi izane amashami menshi: basiga amashami 3 - 4 azasoromwaho ibibabi. Bafumbiza ifumbire y'imborera: toni 20 kuri Ha na NPK 20. 10. 10 cyangwa kg 400 - 500za NPK 25. 5 kuri Ha. Ni byiza gusasiza ibyatsi kugira ngo ubutaka bugumane ubuhehere no kugabanya imirimo yo kubagara.

Amagweja agaburirwa mu byiciro bikurikira: Amageweja agira ibyiciro bitanu. Akivuka, agaburirwa mu minsi 3 hanyuma agasinzira, akiyuburura ariko yiyongera mu bunini. Bongera kuyagaburira mu minsi 3, hanyuma agasinzira, akiyuburura yiyongera ubunini. Bongera kuyagaburira iminsi 4, agasinzira, hanyuma akiyuburura yiyongera ubunini. Bongera kugaburira iminsi 5, agasinzira akiyuburura yiyongera ubunini. Ubwa nyuma bayagaburira iminsi 8, agasinzira akiyuburura yiyongereye ubunini. Nyuma y'iminsi 25 - 28 ntiyongera kurya, ashyirwa ku matajeri afite ibinogo bimeze nk'igisoro, agatangira gucira urudodo rw'umweru akarwizingiraho ku buryo nyuma y'iminsi 8 aba atakigaragara, amaze gukora ikidongi gishobora kuzingururwamo urudodo rw'ihariri rureshya na m 600 - 1500. Ni ngombwa gukurikiranira hafi amagweja muri iyo minsi, kugira ngo ku munsi wa 8 cyangwa uwa 9 adapfumura urudodo hakagurukamo ibinyugunyugu, akangiza n'urudodo.

kuri hegitari igiye guterwaho soya hajyaho Ifumbire zikurikira: Imborera iboze neza bafumbiza toni 10 kuri hegitari cyangwa ibiro 100 kuri ari. Mugihe wakoresheje rhizobium na DAP ushobora gukoresha toni 5 z'imborera kuri hegitari cg ibiro 50 kuri ari. Imvaruganda ikoreshwa ibiro 100 bya DAP kuri hegitari cyangwa ikiro 1 kuri ari; Mubutaka busharira koresha ishwagara ibyumweru 2 mbere yogutera kukigero cya toni 2 n'igice cyangwa ibiro 25 kuri ari.

Iyo umaze guca imirongo ubanzamo ifumbire y'imborera hanyuma ukanyanyagiza DAP mumurongo, ugatwikirizaho agataka gake kugirango ifumbire itangiza imbuto, ugashyiramo imbuto hanyuma ugatwikiriza itaka.
Ubushakashatsi bwakorewe mu Rwanda bwerekanyeko Rhizobiyumu yongera umusaruro wa soya kukigero cya 20 % kimwe nuwakoresheje ifumbire ya Ire (urea) ingana n'ibiro ijana (100 kg) kuri hegitari imwe.

Indwara y'umugese muri soya iterwa n'agahumyo ko mu bwoko bwaPhakospora pachyrhizi. Uburwayi buhera ku mababi yo hasi bikagenda bizamuka hejuru. Ibimenyetso biranga indwara y'umugese muri soya: Amababi yafashwe agaragazwa n'ifu y'ikigina gishyira umutuku igaragara ku ruhande rwo munsi y'amababi. Amababi yafashwe agira amabara y'umuhondo ku ruhande rwo hejuru nyuma agacikagurika. Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya indwara y'umugese muri soya: Kubahiriza gahunda yo gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima; Gutera imbuto nziza yujuje ubuziranenge bwemewe; Gukoresha imbuto zihanganira iyo ndwara; Gutera imbuto ihungije umuti wica uduhumyo dutera iyo ndwara nka Carbendazim ku rugero rwa: 800 gr / 1 kg cy'imbuto; Mugihe soyayafashwe tera umwe umutiikurikira:

Kubemba kwa soya biterwa n'agakoko ko mu bwoko bwa virus. Ibimenyetso biranga indwara yo kubemba cg mozayike muri soya; Amababi yafashwe arapfunyarara imitwe yayo igasa nk'ishinze, hanyuma igihingwa kiragwingira ntigikure. Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya indwara yo kubemba cyangwa mozayike; Kubahiriza gahunda yo gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima (soya ntisimburana n'ibindi binyamisogwe); Gutera imbuto nziza yujuje ubuziranenge bwemewe yasaruwe mu murima utaragaragayemo indwara yo kubemba; Kurandura mu murima soya yabembye; Gutera umuti wica udusimba nk'ubuhunduguru (aphids) kuko aritwo tuyikwirakwiza.

Inda cg ubuhunduguru ni agasimba gatungwa no kunyunyuza ibimera gafashe kumababi yabyo. Zikwirakwiza virusi nyinshi zitera indwara. Ikindi nuko umushongi w'inda ukurura uduhumyo tw'umukara dutwikira ikibabi bigatuma kidakora neza ibitungagihingwa. Uburyo bwo kwirinda cyangwa kurwanya inda cg ubuhunduguru muri soya: Terera igihe, Ubahiriza igerambuto riteganywa; Gufumbira no kubahiriza imirimo yose ikorerwa soya kugirango ikure neza; Tera imiti yica udusimba nka Lambda - Cyhalothrin: 1 ml / 1L y'amazi cyangwa Azadiractin 0. 3 % EC: 1ml / 1L y'amazi.

Nyamwihina ni agakoko ko mu bwoko bw'ibinyugunyugu kitwa Lamprosema indicata. Ibimenyetso by'indwara ya Nyamwihina muri soya: Igihingwa cyafashwe kigaragazwa n'amababi azingiye hamwe nk'azirikishije utudodo Nyamwihina yihishemo imbere. Nyamwihina yangiza ikibabi ihereye mu nsi kandi itagipfumuye. Igaragara cyane mu gihe cy'izuba; Uburyo bwo Kurinda no kurwanya indwara ya Nyamwihina muri soya: Guhingira igihe; Gutera imiti nka: Cypermethrin: 20 ml / 20 L amzi; Lamda - Cyhalothrin: 20 ml / 20 L y'amazi; Azadirachtin: 20 ml / 20 L y'amazi; Acetamiprid: 10ml / 20L z'amazi.
Urutoki rwishimira ubutaka bw'isi ndende, bwumutse, bworoshye, bufite ubusharire buri hagati ya 5 - 6. 5 kandi bufite ifumbire ihagije.

GUTEGURA UMURIMA UHINGWAMO URUTOKI bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Kurwanya isuri no guhinga umurima neza hamarwamo urwiri n'ibindi byatsi bibi no gucukura imyobo izajyamo insina. Iyo myobo igira santimetero 60 z'ubujyakuzimu na santimetero 90 z'umurambararo. Mu gucukura umwobo itaka ryo hejuru (muri santimetero 40) rishyirwa ukwaryo n'irisigaye hasi rigashyirwa ukwaryo (santimetero 20 zo hasi). Ubutaka buvuye hejuru busubizwa mu mwobo bukavangwa n'ifumbire.

Gufumbira urutoki bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Gutera hakoreshwa ifumbire y'imborera iboze neza iri hagati ya ibiro 20 - ibiro 30 mu mwobo umwe. Urutoki rukenera N, P, K, Ca, Urea. Nyuma insina zimaze gukura, zifumbirwa ku muzenguruko (muri cm 60 uvuye ku nsina) mu gaferege waciye katari karekare kugira ngo imizi y'insina itangirika. Ifumbire y'imborera ishyirwaho byibura kabiri mu mwaka mu gihe cy'imvura (ku muhindo cyangwa itumba ritangiye) ingana na ibiro15 - ibiro25. Imvaruganda ya NPK (17: 17: 17) igenda ishyirwamo gake gake inshuro nyinshi (mu gihe cy'imvura) kugira ngo itazajya yigendera ikajyana n'amazi (ku nsina hajyaho garama 200 za NPK cyangwa garama 200 za Ire kuri buri nsina ku mwaka). Ifumbire mvaruganda yonyine ntishobora gutuma urutoki rwera neza igihe kirekire. Gukoresha imborera n'ifumbire mvaruganda nibwo buryo bwiza cyane kurusha ubundi bwo kubungabunga uburumbuke bw'ubutaka buhinzweho urutoki.

Amashanya n'ubwoko bw'ibyonnyi bitagaragarira amaso, biba mu butaka, mu mizi n'inguri z'insina. Arya imizi agatuma yangirika. Ubwoko bw'amashanya bwangiza cyane (bwitwa Rhodopholus similis) bukunze kuboneka mu kibaya cya Rusizi (mu Bugarama). Akenshi ibimenyetso by'amashanya byitiranywa n'ibimenyetso byo kubura ifumbire n'amazi. Ibyo bimenyetso Indwara y'amashanya mu rutoki ni ibi: Imizi irangirika ntishobore kuzamura amazi n'ibitunga insina; Insina ikura nabi igahinyagara; Insina itinda kwana; Igira igitoki gito; Insina zirandukana n'imizi n'uyo hatari ibibazo by'umuyaga; Uko warwanya amashanya mu rutoki; Ugutera imibyare mizima kandi igaterwa mumurima muzima (utaragaragaye mo ibyonnyi); Guhata umubyare ugiye gutera ugakuraho imizi, ukawinika mu mazi ashyushye yabize amasegonda 30; Urutoki rwafashwe rugomba kurimburwa, umurima ugahingwamo indi myaka (imyumbati, ibijumba n'ibindi urandura insina zishibuka) mu gihe cy'imyaka ibiri, nyuma ushobora kongera guterwamo urutoki.

Uko bategura umurima wo guhingamo ibirayi: Guhinga bwambere (Gutamura) no Kurwanya isuri: N ' uguhinga barima amasinde baterera ibyatsi bibi hejuru kugirango byume bizatange ifumbire. Bikorwa mu gihe cy'izuba kuko bituma ubutaka bwota izuba bityo indwara n'ibyonnyi bikagabanuka mu butaka. Kurwanya isuri bikorwa basibura imirwanyasuri ahari amaterasi yikora kugirango amazi y'imvura azafatwe adatwaye ubutaka. Ku materasi y'indinganire batema ibihuru n'ibyatsi kugirango bitazihishamo indwara n'ibyonnyi. 2. Guhinga bwa kabiri (Gutabira): Bikorwa boroshya ubutaka, ibisinde bikamenwa ubutaka bugasigara buseseka ku buryo amazi, umwuka n'imizi y'igihingwa bizanyuramo ku buryo bworoshye.

Ibijyanye no gutera imbuto y'ibirayi: Igihe cyiza cyo gutera: Ni mu kwezi kwa Nzeri mu gihe cy'ihinga A, muri Werurwe mu gihe cy'ihinga B no muri Nyakanga mu gihe cy'ihinga C mu bishanga n'imibande; kuri are imwe 1 hakoreshwa imbuto iri hagati y'ibiro 20 na 25; Batera kuri sentimetero 80 hagati y'imirongo na sentimetero 30 hagati y'ikirayi n'ikindi ku murongo. Baca utugende cyangwa bagacukura imyobo bifite sentimetero 20 z'ubujyakuzimu. Bashyira ifumbire mborera iboze neza mu tugende cyangwa mu myobo; Bongeraho ifumbire mvaruganda ya NPK 17 - 17 - 17 mu mwobo cyangwa mu tugende; Batera ikirayi 1 mu mwobo cyangwa mu tugende ariko bashyiramo intera ya santimetero 30 hagati y'ikirayi n'ikindi, muri sentimetero 8 ni 10 z'ibujyakuzimu, amaso y'ikirayi areba hejuru.

Ibijyanye no kubagara ibirayi: Kubagara bwa mbere no kumenera: Bikorwa nyuma y'iminsi 15 kugeza kuri 21 ibirayi bimaze kumera bifite uburebure buri hagati ya sentimetero10 na sentimetero 20. Kubagara bwa kabiri, gusukira itaka no kwongeramo imvaruganda: Bikorwa ibirayi bifite uburebure buri hagati ya sentimetero 20 na sentimetero 30. Bikorwa itaka ryegerezwa ku gice cyo hasi cy'ibirayi, bigatuma bizana indi mizi bigakomera kandi bikabona n'umwanya uhagije wo gushoreramo. Wongeramo imvaruganda NPK 17 - 17 - 17 ingana n'ikiro n'igice kuri are imwe.

Indwara y'imvura cyangwa milidiyu yo mubirayi ni indwara iterwa n'agahumyo bita “ Phytophtora infestans ”. Ifata amababi, imigozi n'ibirayi biri mubutaka. Iyo ndwara iterwa n'imvura nyinshi. Igihingwa cyafashwe kizana urubobi ku mababi no ku migozi; nyuma akaba umukara. Iyo bikabije ugira ngo umurima wababutse. Uburyo bwo kurinda no kurwanya indwara y'imvura cyangwa milidiyu mu birayi: Gutera ubwoko bw'imbuto y'ibirayi bwihanganira iyo ndwara; Gutera imbuto nziza ifite icyemezo cy'ubwiza; Guhinga ibirayi mu murima umaze nibura ibihembwe bibili by'ihinga udahinzemo ibirayi; Kurandura ibirayi byimejeje kuko bishobora kubika iyo ndwara bikayikwirakwiza mumurima; Gutera umuti wa Ridomili (Ridomil) ku mababi hose (garama 50 muri litiro 20 z'amazi) inshuro ebyiri (mu ntera y'iminsi 7) ibirayi bikimara kumera. Nyuma y'ibyumweru bibiri batera umuti wa Ditane ku mababi hose (garama 50 muri litiro 20 z'amazi) bagatera inshuro 1 buri cyumweru mu gihe cy'imvura kugeza ibirayi byeze. Gusukira itaka neza ku birayi bituma ibirayi biri mu butaka bitandura.

Urunyo rw'ibirayi ruva mu magi aterwa n'agakoko ko mu bwoko bw'isazi yitwa Liriomyza sp. Iyo sazi ica utwenge mumababi igateramo amagi. Ayo magi asohokamo inyo zikurira mu mababi zikanayarya. Ibimenyetso by'indwara y'URUNYO RW ' IBIRAYI; Urunyo rw'ibirayi ruba mu mababi imbere, rukarya amababi rucamo inzira uko rugenda rwimuka. Izo nzira zigaragara inyuma ku mababi mu ibara ryenda gusa n'ikijuju. Uburyo bwo kwirinda no kurwanya indwara y'URUNYO RW ' IBIRAYI: Guhingira igihe cyagenwe cyo gutera ibirayi; Kurima no gutabira byibuze icyumweru mbere yo gutera ibirayi mu murima kugira ngo udusimba twicwe n'imirasire y'izuba; Gutera umuti wica urunyo nka Imidachloprid mililitiro 30 muri litiro 20 z'amazi cyangwa Abamectin garama 18 muri litiro 1 y'amazi.

Ibirayi bipfunyikwa mu bikoresho byabugenewe bituma ibirayi bihumeka neza: Amagunira, imifuka idoze mu mishipiri, cyangwa mu bitete kugirango bitangirika. Imifuka dusanzwe tumenyereye mu gupfunyika amafu, ibigori, amasukari, ifumbire mvaruganda ntikoreshwa mugupfunyika ibirayi kuko ituma bibora.

Dore ingano y'inyongeramusaruro zikenewe kuri buri garama 3 y'imbuto ya puwavuro, harimo: Ifumbire y'Imboberwa: hagenewe ibiro 250. Ifumbire ya NPK (17. 17. 17): hakenerwa ibiro 4. 7. Ifumbire ya KCl: hakenerwa ibiro 0. 5. Ifumbire ya Ire: hakenerwa ibiro 1. 3. Ingembwe: hakenewe ingemwe 270.

Gutegura ingemwe za puwavuro mu buhumbikiro bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Ubuhumbikiro bushyirwa ahantu hatigeze hahingwa ibihingwa byo mu muryango umwe na puwavuro (ibirayi, inyanya, intoryi, urusenda n'ibindi) nibura mu bihembwe by'ihinga bibiri bishize. Ubuso bw'ubuhumbikiro bugomba kuba 1 % by'umurima wose uzaterwamo. Mbese metero kare imwe ku murima wa Ari imwe. Hategurwa ubuhumbikiro bufite ubugali bwa metero imwe kugeza kuri m1. 2 n'ubujyejuru bwa cm 20 kugirango amazi abashe gusohoka mu butaka. Vanga amashyi atatu y'imborera iboze neza （ ibiro 3 kugera kuri 5 ） hejuru: amashyi atatu yuzuye (ibilo 3 kugera ku bilo 5) kuri metero kare imwe, na garama 20 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 (udufuniko 2 tw'icupa ry'amazi) icyumweru kimwe mbere yo guhumbika. Igihe cyo kwinaza, ringaniza ubutaka, uce imirongo yo kwinazamo ifite ubujyakuzimu bwa cm 0. 5 kandi itandukanijwe na santimetero 10 kugera kuri santimetero 15. Umurama ushyirwa muri ya mirongo yaciwe ku ntera ya santimetero 2 hagati y'imbuto; hanyuma hakarenzwaho agataka gacye bagatsindagira gahoro.

Imirimo ikorwa mu kwita ku buhumbikiro bwa puwavuro ni iyi ikurikira: Gusasira hakoreshejwe ibyatsi byumye neza. Nyuma y'iminsi 7 kugeza ku minsi 10, ingemwe ziba zimaze kumera maze isaso igakurwaho. Vomerera mu gitondo kare na nimugoroba. Ubaka igisharagati ariko usige aho imirasire y'izuba inyura haboneke urumuri ruringaniye. Bagara buri gihe ndetse wicire ingemwe mugihe zicucitse. Tera umuti urwanya indwara mu gihe aringombwa. Gabanya kuvomerera mu byumweru bibiri mbere yo kugemura.

Dore iby'ingenzi mu gutera puwavuro: Umurima uhingwa neza ku bujyakuzimu bwa santimetero 30. Vomerera ingemwe mbere yo kuzitera uzitere mu gitondo kare; Puwavuro ziterwa ku ntera ya santimetero 60 hagati y'imirongo na santimetero 45 mu murongo. Cukura imyobo y'ubujyakuzimu bwa santimetero 15. Mumwobo umwe hajyamo ifumbire y'imborera yuzuye amashyin ' agafuniko k'icupa ry'amazi kuzuye NPK 17 - 17 - 17. Shyira KCL agafuniko ka fanta kuzuye neza mu myobo ine) mu gihe cyo gutera.

Imirimo y'ingenzi mu kwita kuri puwavuro ni iyi ikurikira: Gusasira: bikorwa mbere cyangwa nyuma yo gutera. Kuvomerera: Bikorwa ukimara gutera bigakomeza igihe cyose ari ngombwa. Irinde gutosa amababi kugirango uburwayi butabona aho bwororokera. Kongeraho ifumbire ya Ire ingana n'agafuniko ka fanta kuzuye kadasendereye kuri buri gihingwa ku minsi 30 nyuma yo gutera. Kubagara: Bikorwa igihe cyose ibyatsi bibi bigaragara mu murima Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi. Kubagara: Bikorwa igihe cyose ibyatsi bibi bigaragara mu murima Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi.

Ibimenyesho by'indwara ya virus ya puwavuro (Imfunyarazi, mozayike, …) ni ibi bikurikira: kugwingira kw'igihingwa, kwikunja kw'amababi, kuma ibice by'amababi n'uruti, kubemba kw'amababi. Indwara ziterwa na virusi zikwirakwizwa muri puwavuro n'imbuto zirwaye, isazi y'umweru n'inda z'ibihingwa. Kwirinda no kurwanya Virus ya puwavuro (Imfunyanzi, mozayike.) Kurwanya udukoko dukwirakwiza ubu burwayi. Gutera imbuto itarwaye. Nta miti yihariye yica virus ahubwo ukoresha imiti irwanya udukoko dukwirakwiza iyi virus urugero: profenofos 40EC Roketi (Rocket).

Ibimenyetso byo kubora cyangwa Ububore bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto (Blossom end rot): Indiba ya puwavuro ihinduka umweru wijimye. Uko puwavuro ihisha ahafashwe hahinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina Ububore buterwa n'ibura ry'umunyungugu wa Calcium, bigaterwa cyane n'amazi make aba ari mu butaka. Azote nyinshi mu butaka ishyira igihingwa mu murongo wo kwandura iyi ndwara. Kwirinda no kurwanya Ububore bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto rwa puwavuro (Blossom end rot) Kuhira witoze mugihe cy'ubushyuhe humagaye cyane cyane mu cyiciro cyo kuzana urubuto. Mu gihe bigaragara ko ubutaka bwawe busharira koresha ishwagara ibiro 25 kuri Ari, yivange n'ubutaka ibyumweru bibiri mbere yo gutera; Gukoresha ifumbire igereranije. Gusasira ubutaka hakoreshejwe isaso nziza kugira ngo bugumane ubuhehere.

Gutegura ingemwe z'urusenda mu buhumbikiro bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Ubuhumbikiro bushyirwa ahantu hatigeze hahingwa ibihingwa byo mu muryango umwe n'urusenda (ibirayi, inyanya, intoryi, puwavuro n'ibindi) nibura mu bihembwe by'ihinga bibiri bishize. Ubuso bw'ubuhumbikiro bugomba kuba 1 % by'umurima wose uzaterwamo. Mbese metero kare imwe ku murima wa Ari imwe. Hategurwa ubuhumbikiro bufite ubugali bwa metero imwe kugeza kuri metero 1. 2 n'ubujyejuru bwa santimetero 20 kugirango amazi abashe gusohoka mu butaka. Vanga amashyi atatu y'imborera iboze neza ibiro 3 - 5 n'ubutaka bwo hejuru: amashyi atatu yuzuye ibiro 3 - 5 kuri metero kare imwe, na garama 20 za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 udufuniko 2 tw'icupa ry'amazi icyumweru kimwe mbere yo guhumbika. Igihe cyo kwinaza, ringaniza ubutaka, uce imirongo yo kwinazamo ifite ubujyakuzimu bwa cm 0. 5 kandi itandukanijwe na santimetero 10 kugera kuri 15. Umurama ushyirwa muri ya mirongo yaciwe ku ntera ya santimetero 2 hagati y'imbuto; hanyuma hakarenzwaho agataka gacye bagatsindagira gahoro.

Ibimenyetso by'akaribata mu rusenda (Anthracnose) Akaribata ni indwara yangiza cyane urusenda rweze. Agahumyo kagira ibidomo byirabura bivamo amazi. Ibi bidomo biboneka k'urusenda rukiri rubisi n'urweze. Aka gahumyo gakwirakwizwa n'imbuto zirwaye. Kurinda no kurwanya akariba mu rusenda (Anthracnose) Gukoresha imbuto z'indobanure zitarwaye. kugirira isuku umurima bavanamo ibisagazwa by'urusenda nyuma y'isarura. Gukoresha ubwoko bwimbuto budafatwa n'indwara; Gukoresha umuti nka chlorothalonil, 50 % wp cyangwa copper oxychloride 50 % wp; Ibipimo bikoreshwa: 10g / l10 z'amazi. 37g / 15l z'amazi.

Ibimenyetso bya virusi z'urusenda (imfunyarazi, mozayike) ni ibi: kugwingira kw'igihinga, kwikunja kw'amababi, kuma ibice by'amababi n'uruti, kubemba kw'amababi. Indwara ziterwa na virusi zikwirakwizwa mu rusenda n'imbuto zirwaye, isazi y'umweru thrips n'inda z'ibihingwa. Kurinda no kurwanya virusi z'urusenda bikorwa bitya: Kurwanya udukoko dukwirakwiza ubu burwayi. Gutera imbuto itarwaye. Nta miti yihariye yica virus. Ahubwo ukoresha imiti irwanya udukoko nka profenofos 40EC. Ibipimo bikoreshwa ku muti wica virus z'urusenda:

Ibimenyetso by'ububobere bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto mu rusenda (blossom end rot) ni ibi bikurikira: Indiba y'urusenda ihinduka umweru wijimye, uko urusenda ruhisha ahafashwe hahinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina. Ububore buterwa n'ibura ry'umunyungugu wa Calcium, bigaterwa cyane n'amazi make aba ari mu butaka. Azote nyinshi mu butaka ishyira igihingwa mu murongo wo kwandura iyi indwara. Kwirinda no kurwanya y'ububobere bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto (blossom end rot) Kuhira witonze mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe humagaye cyane cyane mu cyiciro cyo kuzana urubuto. Gukoresha ifumbire igereranije. Gushyira ishwagara mu butaka igihe ari ngombwa. Gusasira Ubutaka kugirango bugumana ubuhehere. Mu gihe bigaragara ko ubutaka bwawe busharira koresha ishwagara ibiro 25 kuri ari yivange n'ubutaka ibyumweru bibiri mbere yo gutera.

Imirimo ikorwa mu kwita ku buhumbikiro bw'inyanya ni iyi ikurikira: Gusasira hakoreshejwe ibyatsi byumye neza. Nyuma y'iminsi 47, ingemwe ziba zimaze kumera maze isaso igakurwaho. Vomerera mu gitondo kare na nimugoroba. Ubaka igisharagati ariko usige aho imirasire y'izuba inyura haboneke urumuri ruringaniye. Bagara buri gihe ndetse wicire ingemwe mugihe zicucitse. Tera umuti urwanya indwara mu gihe ari ngombwa. Gabanya kuvomerera mu byumweru bibiri mbere yo kugemura. Ingemwe zigemurwa zimaze ibyumweru 4 mu buhumbikiro amababi 34.

Imirimo y'ingenzi yo kwita ku gihingwa cy'inyanya ni iyi ikurikira: Gusasira: bikorwa mbere cyangwa nyuma yo gutera. Kuvomerera: Bikorwa ukimara gutera bigakomeza igihe cyose ari ngombwa. Irinde gutosa amababi kugirango uburwayi butabona aho bwororokera. Gushyiraho imfumbire mvaruganda: kuri buri rugemwe bashyiraho garama 10 ingana n'agapfundikizo kuzuye k'icupa ry'amazi za NPK 17 - 17 - 17 icyumweru kimwe nyuma yo gutera na garama 5 bingana n'agafuniko kuzuye kadasendereye k'icupa rya Fanta ibyumweru 6 nyuma yo gutera cyangwa kugemura. Iyi fumbire ishyirwa ku muzenguruko w'urugemwe aho iminizi igarukira. Kubagara: Bikorwa igihe cyose ibyatsi bibi bigaragara mu murima; Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi.

Gusarura no gufata neza umusaruro w'inyanya bikorwa bitya: Sarura inyanya ugendeye kuzo abaguzi bifuza. Ibara inyanya zifite niryo ryerekana uko zihiye; Sarura mugitondo cg nimugororoba kugirango uzirinde kwangizwa n'izuba; Koresha icyuma cg umukasi ufite isuku mu kwirinda indwara. Tandukanya inyanya zihiye cyane n'izidahiye neza wirinda ko zatera izindi kubora. Koresha amakurete, amabase cyangwa ibitebo bikomeye kandi wirinde kubyuzuza cyane kugirango wirinde ko zangirika mu gihe cyo kuzikorera. Irinde gutera umuti wica udukoko ku nyanya zasaruwe.

Ibiranga Indwara y'imvura (Kababu) mu nyanya; Iyi ndwara ikara cyane mu gihe cy'ubukonje n'ubuhehere bwinshi, Ikwirakwira vuba ikaba yakwangiza igihingwa mu gihe gito, Iyi ndwara ifata ibice byose by'igihingwa. Ibimenyestso bigaragara munsi y'amababi nkuruhumbu naho hejuru y'amababi bisa nkicyababutse. Uko birinda Indwara y'imvura (Kababu) mu nyanya; Gusimburanya ibihingwa. Isuku mu murima. Kudatera ingemwe hafi y'inyanya zikuze. Kuvanaho ibisambo kugirango urumuri rubashe kwinjira mo. Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb (Dithane, Safari - Zeb) cyangwa Mancozeb + Metalaxyl (Ridomyl, Victory,...). Uko bavura Indwara y'imvura (Kababu) mu nyanya; Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb + Metalaxyl (Ridomyl, Victory,...). gukoresha imiti irimo cuivre nka FUGURAN; Vanga garama 50 z'umuti muri litiro 20 z'amazi;

Ibiranga Indwara y'ibidomo ku mababi n'imbuto (Early Blight) Iyi ndwara iterwa n'agahumyo kitwa Alternaria solani. Ikagaragazwa n'ibidomo bisa n'ikigina birimo inziga ku mababi, ku ruti no kumbuto aho inkondo ifatiye. Ikunda kuboneka mu bice bishyuha kandi bifite ubuhehere buke. Uko birinda Indwara y'ibidomo ku mababi n'imbuto (Early Blight) Gusimburanya ibihingwa bitari mu muryango umwe nyuma y'ibihembwe bitatu, Kwirinda ko umurima urekamo amazi, Gukura mu murima ibisigazwa by'inyanya, Guha igihingwa ifumbire ihagije. Ibyiza ni ushyiramo inyongeramusaruro mu byiciro bitatu.

Ibiranga Indwara y'Ububore bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto (Blossom end rot) Ububore buterwa n'ibura ry'umunyungugu wa kalisiyumu, bigaterwa cyane n'amazi make aba ari mu butaka. Mu bihe by'ubushyuhe cg igihe hiriwe humagaye bakavomereza amazi menshi, bituma igihingwa kidashobora gufata vuba kalisiyumu mubutaka. Uko birinda Ububore bwo mu ndiba y'urubuto (Blossom end rot) Kuhira witonze mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe humagaye cyane cyane mu cyiciro cyo kuzana urubuto. Gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera ihagije. Gushyira ishwagara mu butaka igihe ari ngombwa. Gusasira Ubutaka kugirango bugumane ubuhehere.

Kwita ku buhumbikiro bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Gusasira hakoreshejwe ibyatsi byumye neza. Nyuma y'iminsi hagati yi 7ni 10, ingemwe ziba zimaze kumera maze isaso igakurwaho. Vomerera mu gitondo kare na nimugoroba. Ubaka igisharagati ariko usige aho imirasire y'izuba inyura haboneke urumuri ruringaniye. Bagara buri gihe ndetse wicire ingemwe mugihe zicucitse. Tera umuti urwanya indwara mu gihe ari ngombwa. Gabanya kuvomerera mu byumweru bibiri mbere yo kugemura.

Ibiranga Indwara y'imvura cyangwa Milidiyu mu bitunguru; Ibidomo cyangwa amabara byeruruka ku mababi bitwikiriwe n'agafu k'ikigina. Amababi areruruka nyuma akaba umuhondo. Imitwe y'amababi iruma. Uko birinda Indwara y'imvura cyangwa Milidiyu mu bitunguru; Kwirinda gutera ingemwe zirwaye, Gusimburanya neza ibihingwa, Gutera mu butaka bwumutse, Kudacucika ibitunguru igihe cyo gutera, Kuvana mu murima ibisagazwa by'ibihingwa bigakorwamo ifumbire, Gutera umuti wo kurwanya uduhumyo. Uko bavura Indwara y'imvura cyangwa Milidiyu mu bitunguru; Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb + Metalaxyl cyangwa gukoresha imiti irimo copper nka Copper oxychloride ku bipimo bya 37. 5g / 15l z'amazi.

Ibiranga Indwara y'ibidomo cyangwa Ariterinariyoze mu bitunguru; Iyi ndwara igaragara mu gihe cy'imvura nyinshi. Itangira igaragazwa n'ibikomere biretse amazi ku mababi nyuma bikaba ikigina. Nyuma, irangwa n'ibidomo byijimye imbere ariko byerurutse ku; muzenguruko wabyo; Uko birinda Indwara y'ibidomo cyangwa Ariterinariyoze mu bitunguru; Gutera igihe cyiza bitewe n'aho umurima uherereye, Amoko y'ibitunguru bigira ubwoya yihanganira ubu burwayi ugereranije n'atabugira, Gutera ku mitabo, no gutegura neza umurima. Kudacucika ibitunguru; igihe cyo gutera, Gusimburanya ibihingwa, Kuvana mu murima ibisigazwa by'ibihingwa, Gutera mu butaka bwumutse. Icyitonderwa: Ubutaka burekamo amazi ntibuberanye n'ibitunguru. Uko bazivura Indwara y'ibidomo cyangwa Ariterinariyoze mu bitunguru; Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb + Metalaxyl cyangwa gukoresha imiti irimo copper nka Copper oxychloride ku gipimo cya garama 37. 5g muri litiro 15 z'amazi.

Gutera tungurusumu bikorwa muburyo bukurikira: Hinga neza ku bujyakuzimu bwa sentimetero 30; uringanie umurima kandi, umenagure ibinonko byose ndetse ukuremo amabuye n'ibyatsi. Ca uduferege dufite ubujyakuzimu bwa sentimetero 5 dutandukanijwe na sentimetero 20. Ushyiremo imborera yuzuyeye amashyi, NPK 17 17 17 cyangwa agafuniko ka fanta kuzuye ku murongo wa metero imwe na KCl agafuniko kamwe ka fanta ku murongo wa metero ebyiri uyivange neza n'itaka.

Kwita ku gihingwa cya tungurusumu bikorwa mu buryo bukurikira: Gusasira: Ukimara gutera, sasira umurima wawe ukoresheje ibyatsi byumye neza. Kuvomerera: Bikorwa ukimara gutera bigakomeza igihe cyose ari ngombwa. Irinde gutosa amababi kugirango uburwayi butabona aho bwororokera. Kubagara: Bikorwa igihe cyose hagarayemo ibyatsi bibi. Kunyuza isuka mu murima mbere yuko ibijumba bitangira gukura nibyiza kuko byoroshya ubutaka bikabona aho bibyibuhira. Ntabwo ari byiza guhinga mu murima wa tungurusumu ibijumba byaramaze gukura kuko byatuma byangirika. Kongeraho Ire: Nyuma y'ibyumweru 6 uteye, shyiramo ifumbire ya Ire ingana n'agafuniko kamwe ka fanta ku murongo wa metero imwe. Kurwanya indwara n'ibyonnyi: bikorwa kimwe nko ku bitunguru.

Ibiranga Indwara y'imvura (Downy mildew) muri watermelon; Iyi ndwara irangwa n'ibara ry'umuhondo ukeye ku bice by'ikibabi. Mu gihe cy'ubukonje, uruhumbu; rufite ibara ry'ikijuju gishyira; umweru rugaragara mu nsi y'amababi. Amababi arwaye arihinahina hanyuma akuma. Iyi ndwara ikwirakwizwa n'imvura n'umuyaga. Uko birinda Indwara y'imvura (Downy mildew) muri watermelon; Kwirinda gutera ingemwe zirwaye, Gusimburanya neza ibihingwa, Gutera mu butaka bwumutse, Kudacucika ibitunguru igihe cyo; gutera, Kuvana mu murima ibisagazwa by'ibihingwa bigakorwamo ifumbire, Gutera umuti wo kurwanya uduhumyo. Uko bavura Indwara y'imvura (Downy mildew) muri watermelon; Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb wongeyeho Metalaxyl cyangwa gukoresha imiti irimo copper nka Copper oxychloride ku bipimo bya garama 37. 5 muri litiro15 z'amazi.

Ibiranga Akaribata (anthracnose) muri watermelon; Ni indwara yangiza cyane wotameloni n'ibindi bihaza. ifata ibice byo hejuru y'ubutaka. Igaragazwa n'ibidomo by'ikigina ku mababi akuze, ahafashwe nyuma haruma hakaba umukara ndetse hagatoboka. Ibimenyetso byo ku mababi bishobora no kugaragara no ku gihaza (imyobo y'ikigina ku gihaza). Uko birinda Akaribata (anthracnose) muri watermelon; Gutera imbuto zihanganira indwara, Gusimburanya neza ibihingwa: Kurandura inzuzi z'ibihaza zimejeje. Uko bavura Akaribata (anthracnose) muri watermelon; Gutera umuti urimo Mancozeb wongeyeho Metalaxyl cyangwa gukoresha imiti irimo copper nka Copper oxychloride ku gipimo cya garama 37. 5g muri litiro15 z'amazi.

Ibiranga Inda cyangwa Ubuhunduguru muri watermelon; Ni agakoko gafite nka milimetero hagati y'imwe n'ebyiri z'uburebure; gatungwa no kunyunyuza; ibimera gafasheho. Gafata cyane cyane amababi n'uruti bikiri bito, indabo n'amababi yo hasi. Inda zikwirakwiza virusi nyinshi zitera indwara. Umushongi w'inda ukurura uduhumyo; tw'umukara dukwikira ikibabi bigatuma kitakore neza ibitungagihingwa. Uko birinda Inda cyangwa Ubuhunduguru muri watermelon; Kubungabunga inshuti z'abahinzi udukoko turya inda. Urugero: Utunyamacwende, urutambara, … Kwirinda guhora ukoresha ubwoko bw'umuti umwe kuko inda ziwumenyere ntizipfe ahubwo zikororoka vuba.

Ibiranga urunyi rw'ibishyimbo mu miteja ni ibi: Ibishyimbo byafashwe bihinduka umuhondo, ku ruti ahagana ku butaka haba hasadutse. Urunyo rwinjira mu ruti rukarya igishyimbo kimaze kugondora cg kikiri mu butaka; Uko barwanya urunyo rw'ibishyimbo mu miteja; Gutera imbuto zihungiye n'umuti wa Imidachropride. Gukora isimburana bihingwa ryiza n'ibindi bihingwa bitari ibinyamisogwe, kuhira (earthing - up) ibihingwa; Gutera imiti uyisimburanya nka: Cypermethrine, Lambda cyhalothrine na Deltamethrin.

Ibimenyetso biranga umugese wo mu miteja ni ibi; Utudomo tw'umugese tugaragara ku bice byo hejuru y'ubutaka ku miteja. Utudomo dusa n'udutukura tumeze nk'udusohotse mu nsi y'ikibabi tuzengurutswe n'ibara ry'umuhondo. Amababi ashobora guhunguka yose. Uko barwanya umugese wo mu miteja; Koresha imbuto nziza zizewe kandi zihungiwe na Benlate. Kora isimbura bihingwa neza. Randura ibyafashwe cg birwaye cyane. Tera umuti mbere yo kuzana ururabo nka Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole, Azoxystrobin, Chlorothalonil.

Ibimenyetso biranga Virusi cyangwa imfunyarazi mu miteja ni ibi bikurikira: Indwara ikwirakwizwa n'inda. Amababi arikunja akagira amabara y'umuhondo uvanze n'icyatsi kibisi. Ibihingwa byafashwe bigira imiteja mito kandi yigonze. Ishobora gukwirakwiza n'imbuto yanduye; Uko barwanya Virusi cyangwa imfunyarazi mu miteja; Koresha imbuto nziza kandi yizewe. Guhungiza imbuto umuti w'ubusimba nka Imidaclopride. Randura ibishyimbo bigaragaye ho uburwayi. Tera imiti uyinyuranya muri ubu bwoko: Lambda Cyhalothrin, Alpha cyper, Abamectin na Azadirachtin (Nimbecidine) igihe hari inda mu murima.

Ibimenyetso biranga uruhumbu rw'umweru mu miteja ni ibi: Uruhumbu rw'umweru rugaragara hejuru y'amababi. Aho uruhumbu rufashe ku kibabi hahita hahinduka umutuku nyuma amababi yose yafashwe akaba umuhondo agahunguka. Uko barwanya uruhumbu rw'umweru mu miteja; Hinga utabira ibisigazwa byose nyuma yo gusarura. Simbuza neza ibihingwa wirinda gusubiza ibishyimbo aho bisaruwe. Bagara kare ibyatsi bitarakura cyane. Ushobora gukoresha imiti ubonye ibimenyetso nka:

Ibimenyetso biranga kirabiranya yo mu miteja; Ibishimbo byafashwe biragwingira bikiri bito. Amababi ahinduka umuhondo ahereye hasi nyuma igihingwa cyose kikuma. Umuzi muremure uratukura naho indi yo mu mpande ikanga gukura. Uko barwanya kirabiranya yo mu miteja; Kora isimbura bihingwa rinoze wirinda gutera ibishyimbo aho bivuye. Kuvana ibisigazwa by'imyaka mu murima nyuma yo gusarura. Irinde ikigunda mu murima. Randura ibishyimbo byafashwe; Tera imiteja mu butaka butareka amazi. Koresha imbuto nziza kandi yizewe. Tera imiti nka Carbendazim, Defeconazole.

Gutegura ingemwe z'imyembe zizabangurwa: Guhumbika ibibuto bikorerwa mu butaka bwiza, buseseka, burimo ifumbire ihagije, kandi butari mu gishanga. Ibibuto biterwa ku mirongo byegeranye, bikarenzwaho agataka gake, bigatwikirizwa utwatsi duke hanyuma bikavomererwa kenshi igihe ari ngombwa. Ibibuto bimera mu byumweru bitatu igihe hatewe ikibuto bitonoye. Mu gihe hatewe ibibuto bidatonoye, bimera kugeza ku byumweru umunani. Gutera ibibuto bitonoye biba byiza cyane kuko haterwa ibyizewe ko ari bizima bidafite ibivumvuri imbere cyangwa ngo bibe byaraboze. Hategurwa ibihoho bishyirwamo itaka ryiza rivanze n'ifumbire kandi bipfumaguye.

Gutegura umurima wo gutera mo imyembe bikorwa bitya: Hinga umurima neza uvanemo urwiri. Ni ngombwa kubanza kugaragaza mu murima ahazaterwa ibiti by'imyembe, hagashingwa imambo. Cukura imyobo ya santimetero 60 kugera ku 100 impande na santimetero 60 kugera ku 100 ibujyakuzimu (ibi bipimo bigenda bihinduka bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ubutaka). Igitaka cyohejuru gishirwa uruhande rumwe aricyo gisubiramo kivanze n'ifumbire, ibyo bigakorwa nibura icyumweru mbere yo gutera. Mu mwobo umwe hashyirwamo imborera ingana nibura n'ibase nigice; Ku ngemwe zibanguriye, intera hagati y'igiti n'ikindi no hagat y'imirongo iba metero 5 iyo nta yindi myaka iteganya guterwamo cyangwa se metero 6 kugeza kuri metero 7 iyo uteganya guhingamo indi myaka. Imyembe iterwa mu ntangiriro y'imvura kuva muri Nzeri kugeza mu Ugushyingo. Mu gutera igihoho kivanwaho hagasigara igitaka gikikije imizi kugirango ingemwe zifate neza.
